notes.title: SE36 Approaches
notes.content: [p]SE36 Approaches[/p][p]SE36 is about to start![/p][p]· At 0:00 on October 1, 2025, Onmyoji: The Card Game will usher in Season 36. Generous rewards await you, including the Season Special Basic Alternative Art "Nekomata: Radiant Banquet - Sea Salt Jelly," Season-exclusive Battlefield Effect "Rebirth: Taiji," Avatar "Nekomata: Radiant Banquet," Card back "Embers of Sorrow," Derivative Card Sparkle Card "Sparkle Card: Power Shift," Transition Wallpaper "Dragon Strategy," in-game emoji pack, Glass Card Frame: Basic, and more![/p][p]· There is a higher chance of getting cards that you don't have yet when getting the SSR cards in the Tour Pass Rewards. If you've got all of them, then you'll have a higher chance of getting cards that you have fewer than 2 copies of.[/p][p]Standard Ranked Match Balance Changes[/p][p]The following cards have been adjusted and nerfed:[/p][p]Fire Attack[/p][p]Before adjustment: Enhance: If Fire Divine Ability is attached, Karasu Tengu: Akiba gains +2 Attack Power and Piercing when attacking a Shikigami. If Sword Divine Ability is attached, this card gains Fast.[/p][p]After adjustment: Enhance: If Fire Divine Ability is attached, Karasu Tengu: Akiba gains +1 Power and Piercing when attacking a Shikigami. If Sword Divine Ability is attached, this card gains Fast.[/p][p]Snow Shadow[/p][p]Before adjustment: Deal 2 damage to an opponent Shikigami and draw a card. Enhance: When Feng Yangjun casts "Snow Flow," gain Fast; when casting "Clear Sky Flow," additionally deal 1 damage to the opponent Player.[/p][p]After adjustment: Deal 2 Damage to an opponent's Shikigami. Enhance: When Feng Yangjun attaches "Snow Flow," this card gains Fast. When attaching "Clear Sky Flow," it additionally deals 1 Damage to the opponent player.[/p][p]Sharpshot[/p][p]Before adjustment: Fast#rHakuro gains 1 Power and Pierce until after the next attack.[/p][p]Adjusted: Fast#rDraw 1 card, Hakuro gains 1 Power and Pierce until after the next attack.[/p][p]Hack and Slash[/p][p]Before adjustment: Piercing Immune to attack damage. Attack an opponent Shikigami in the Standby Zone during this combat instead.[/p][p]After adjustment: Piercing. Immune to attack damage. If the opponent has a Shikigami in the Standby Zone that is not defeated, this combat will target one of the opponent's Standby Zone Shikigami instead.[/p][p]Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on October 1, 2025. (Up to twice for each type)[/p][p]【"Alternation Omnius" Reinforce Cards Grand Launch】[/p][p]· Four new Reinforce Cards will be added to the Alternation Omnius Card Packs after the maintenance on September 25, 2025. [/p][p]· After the new Alternation Omnius Reinforce Cards become available on September 25, players will be able to claim 3 free Alternation Omnius Card Packs by logging into the game. [/p][p]· The "Alternation Omnius Reinforce Card Welcome Pack" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on September 25, 2025. The pack contains 15 Alternation Omnius Card Packs.[/p][p]· The "Alternation Omnius Reinforce Card Special Pack" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on September 25, 2025. The pack contains 35 Alternation Omnius Card Packs and a random Alternation Omnius SSR Card Pack.[/p][p]· The "Alternation Omnius Reinforce Card Collector's Gift Box" will be available in the Jade Shop after the maintenance on September 25, 2025. The gift box contains 50 Alternation Omnius Card Packs and one random Alternation Omnius SSR Card Gift Box.[/p][p]【Reinforce Card Acquisition Event – Matsu Melody and Vine Dance Now Open】[/p][p]· Event Time: From after the maintenance on September 25, 2025, to 24:00 on October 22, 2025.[/p][p]· Event Description:[/p][p]  During the event period, players can claim 10 "Reinforce Points" daily on the event interface.[/p][p]  Each victory in a match grants an additional 10 "Reinforce Points," with a daily limit of 40 points (applicable to Ranked Match/Player Match/Card Game/Investigation/Shotengai Battle/Hyakubun Chess/Shinro Deep Secret Record).[/p][p]  Players can earn 20 "Reinforce Points" by making their first recharge of any amount each day.[/p][p]  Accumulate "Reinforce Points" to obtain SSR-quality Reinforce Cards, SR cards of the corresponding Shikigami, a 14-day Trial Card for the Shikigami, and rewards such as Alternation Omnius Scrolls on the event page.[/p][p]· Event Notice[/p][p]  Each player can claim up to 10 Reinforce Points on the event page for daily login. These points will be refreshed at 00:00 daily. Please remember to claim your Reinforce Points in time.[/p][p]  Players can earn 10 Reinforce Points each time they win in Ranked Match/Player Match/Card Game/Investigation Club/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess. Each player can complete this task up to 4 times per day. The task will refresh daily at 0:00.[/p][p]  Players will receive 20 Reinforce Points for their first recharge of any amount each day. The first recharge will reset daily at 00:00.[/p][p]· The reward claim page will close along with the event page at 24:00 on October 22, 2025. Unclaimed rewards will be sent via in-game mail.[/p][p]· Players who did not obtain Reinforce Cards during the event can still synthesize Reinforce Cards later using Talismans.[/p][p]【Standard Ranked Match/Departure Ranked Match Optimization】[/p][p]· A new button has been added, allowing players to skip the Beginner Ranked Match and directly enter the Standard Ranked Match. When skipping the Beginner Ranked Match, players can claim all unclaimed rewards from it.[/p][p]· The Shikigami Experience Pack in the Departure Ranked Match phase has had its usage level restriction removed. Additionally, the range of Shikigami available for experience has been expanded to allow players to choose one Shikigami from any Card Pack.[/p][p]· When players are in the Ranked Match: Departure phase and have not yet claimed the Departure Prebuilt Deck, a small prompt will appear on the interface reminding them to claim the deck.[/p][p]【Boyfriend Story Series - Poverty God: Gamer Girl Collector Edition Alternative Art Available】[/p][p]· The Collector Edition Alternative Art "Gamer Girl" will be available in the Alternative Art Shop after the maintenance on September 25, 2025. A limited-time discount will also be available. The discount event will end at 24:00 on October 8, 2025.[/p][p]Other Improvements and Bug Fixes[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Hakuro's Power-up Spell cards used before attaching the "Zanshin" form were not applying the "Zanshin" effect.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Langya Zi's Basic Card incorrectly displayed as a black-and-white card after being revived by the "Immortality Pill" effect and gaining the Substitute ability from Fujihime's "Wisteria Hue" effect, upon receiving fatal damage.[/p][p]· Fixed an incorrect card description for Aobozu · Dust "Purification and Clarity."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where cards obtained through You Ning's "Pure Thoughts" effect would still be discarded at the end of the turn if they returned to the hand in subsequent turns due to other effects.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Karasu Tengu · Akiha's "Unbeatable" effect would not immediately double when three different Divine Powers were present on the player's field, requiring the use of another card to trigger the doubling.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the card art of the corresponding Shikigami would display abnormally on certain devices after using Evolve Cards.[/p][p]· The special effect color of the card frame for cards that do not consume Orbs has been changed to distinguish them from Fast cards. If a card has both the "does not consume Orbs" and "Fast" effects, it will display as a card frame for "does not consume Orbs."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Yun Ning's Innocent Hymn could not reveal Reinforce Cards.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content: [p]Yunhe Dreamcatcher Gift Box Now Available[/p][p]· The Yunhe Dreamcatcher Gift Box will be available for a limited time after maintenance on September 11, 2025. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.[/p][p]· The gift box contains the Doodle Combat Background "Hide-and-Seek Planet," Card Back "Bamboo Shadows," "Doodle Alternative Art Selection Box," "Yunhe Dreamcatcher Title Selection Box," and "Secret Scroll Selection Box" ×5.[/p][p]· Guests can use the "Yunhe Dreamcatcher Title Selection Box" to choose one of the following Titles to add to their collection: "Golden Brotherhood," "Dancing in Finery," or "Blossoming Together."[/p][p]· Guests can use the "Doodle Alternative Art Selection Box" to choose any set of Doodle Alternative Art released before August 27, 2025 to add to their collection.[/p][p]You can also choose the "Cloud River Dream Gathering Friendship Set," which allows you to gift a "Graffiti Alternative Art Selection Gift Box" and a "Cloud River Dream Gathering Title Selection Gift Box" to a friend. (Cannot be gifted again after sending)[/p][p]Voyage Pass: S8 Now Available[/p][p]· Available Time: From after the maintenance on September 11, 2025.[/p][p]· Guests can spend 248 Jade to purchase the Voyage Pass: S8. Once purchased, Voyage Pass: S8 will be instantly leveled up to Lv.9, allowing guests to immediately earn all exclusive Doodle Alternative Art of the current Voyage Pass: Doodle Alternative Art for Hakuzosu: Tempered Heart's base Shikigami and its full set of 8 cards, along with the corresponding 9 Ink Splash Card Frames.[/p][p]· The Voyage Pass has a total of 30 levels. Guests can earn points by completing the specified point quests to level up the Voyage Pass. Claim corresponding rewards once the Voyage Pass reaches a certain level. Each reward can only be claimed once.[/p][p]· Guests can directly purchase levels for the Voyage Pass at a cost of 3 Jade per level. Please spend money responsibly.[/p][p]The Flowers of Love Qixi Event Is Now Available![/p][p]Event Time: From after the maintenance on September 11, 2025 to 24:00 on September 24, 2025.[/p][p]Event Description:[/p][p]· During the event, guests can obtain Flowers by completing event quests.[/p][p]· Guests can arrange flowers to create and gift bouquets favored by Shikigami. Upon success, you can earn Alternation Omnius Secret Scrolls, Ink Jade, Glass Stone, and Refined Stone as rewards.[/p][p]· Players can repeatedly gift their preferred bouquets to Shikigami, and each gift will grant a Gold reward.[/p][p]· After the event ends, the two Shikigami who received the most bouquets from players will send thank-you emails containing Alternation Omnius Secret Scroll rewards. (You must send at least 3 bouquets)[/p][p]Doodle Alternative Art Limited-time Rerun[/p][p]· Rerun Period: From after maintenance on September 11, 2025 to 23:59 on September 24, 2025.[/p][p]· This rerun includes the following Doodle Alternative Art: "Shinkiro Doodle Alternative Art."[/p][p]Alternative Art Takes Turns to Discount: Thirtieth Turn Begins[/p][p]· Many Alternative Arts which have been sold for over one year will enjoy a discount for a limited time during each turn, guests can head to the Alternative Art Shop to purchase them! [/p][p]· Event Time: From 10:00 on September 11, 2025 to 9:00 on October 30, 2025. [/p][p]· This round's Alternative Art: "Ungaikyo: Mirror of the Alley," "Momo: Abundance," "Langyazi: Miracle Elixir," "Hiyoribou: Sunny Heartbeat Sake," "Sparrow: Cat on the Trip," "Kurumi: Fragrant Dye."[/p][p]Other Improvements and Bug Fixes[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Deck Codes could not be shared if the deck contained too many types of cards, resulting in the code being too long.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the card description of Koi's "Tail Whip" was incorrect. (Actual effect remains unchanged)[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in Mirage Deep Records where some stage descriptions did not match the corresponding stages.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Standard Ranked Match Balance Changes
notes.content: [p]Standard Ranked Match Balance Changes[/p][p]· The following cards have been nerfed:[/p][p]Wishing Moon and Starry River[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +2 Power/+2 Shield[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Basic boost: +2 Power[/p][p]One Night's Dream[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Tactical: Revive one of your other Shikigami or grant one of your other Shikigami +1 Combat Power and initiate an Attack. When used from your Hand, additionally grant the Target Shikigami +1 Power and +1 Health.[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Tactical Revive one of your other Shikigami or grant one of your other Shikigami +1 Power and initiate an Attack. When used from your hand, additionally grant the Target Shikigami +1 Power and +1 Shield.[/p][p]The following cards have been enhanced:[/p][p]Abyss of Purgatory[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Deal 3 Damage to an opponent's Shikigami. Focus: This card has Lifesteal.[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Deal 3 Damage to an opponent's Shikigami. Focus: This card's Damage is increased by 1 and gains Lifesteal.[/p][p]Master of the Original Plains[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Projectile: Deal 3 Damage. Focus: Attach "Nine-Tailed Power" to Tamamonomae of the Scorched Heavens.[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Projectile: Deal 3 Damage. Focus: Choose one: Attach a "Nine-Tailed Power" to Tamamonomae; or randomly use one of Tamamonomae's Origin Spell Cards.[/p][p]Evolve: Bakekujira[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Permanently attach Teeth Shell or Body Shell to Bakekujira. Evolve: Charge. Once per turn, when your Shikigami assault, Bakekujira gains 1 Energy and triggers the attached Teeth Shell and Body Shell one more time.[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Permanently attach Teeth Shell or Body Shell to Bakekujira. Evolve: Charge. Once per turn, when your Shikigami assault, Bakekujira gains 2 Energy and triggers the attached Teeth Shell and Body Shell one more time.[/p][p]Bless[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Randomly increases the level of one of the lowest level Shikigami of both players by +1.[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Increase the level of your lowest level Shikigami and a random lowest level opponent's Shikigami by +1, then draw a card.[/p][p]Hidden Leaf Swordsman[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Base Stats: 3 Power/3 Health[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Basic stats: 4 Power/4 Health[/p][p]Wings of Prayer[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Fast Randomly add a Kaoru Form Card to your hand. Owl's Guard loses Unique (does not stack). In this game, when Owl's Guard is attached to your Shikigami, attach it to all your Shikigami.[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Fast Choose a Kaoru Form Card to add to your hand. Owl's Guard loses Unique (does not stack). In this game, when Owl's Guard is attached to your Shikigami, attach it to all your Shikigami instead.[/p][p]Punishing Hands[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Enhance: Gain Fast during the turn this card is drawn.[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Draw a card, then place a card from your hand on top of your Library. Enhance: Gain Fast during the turn this card is drawn.[/p][p]Thunderclouds[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+1 Shield[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+2 Shield[/p][p]Mt. Ibuki[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Intensity: 4[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Intensity: 6[/p][p]Heat Wave[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Hunt Enhance: This card gains +2 Power and +2 Shield for every Delicacy card you gain during this game.[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Hunt Enhance: For each "Delicacy" you obtain during this game, this card gains +2 Power and +2 Shield. Trick: Hunt.[/p][p]Destined One[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: At the start of your turn, add a Wind Blade to your Hand.[/p][p]After the Adjustment: When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, add a Wind Blade to your Hand.[/p][p]Turbulent Blade[/p][p]Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+0 Shield[/p][p]After the Adjustment: Basic boost: +1 Power/+0 Shield[/p][p]Other Improvements and Bug Fixes[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where an opponent's Shikigami attached with the Invocation "Freeze" from Fengyang Jun would reattach "Freeze" upon taking Damage from Fengyang Jun's "Clear Snow Stream" Invocation.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Oni Gold Sheep's "Master of Oni Stars" ability would still grant Direct Hit after an opponent's Shikigami with Power greater than or equal to 5 entered the Combat Zone and then left the Combat Zone.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where "Evolve: Ryomen" would not correctly grant Power boosts when consecutively using "Thunder Fury."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Ungaikyo's "Hidden Sun" would only trigger the Projectile effect once when consecutively using "Hidden Sun."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the displayed dice points of Yamausagi/Zashiki's "Lucky Dice" card did not match its actual effect when using the Shiny variant.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Shinkiro's "Hundred Knowledge · Blue Leaf" would not count towards the usage count of "Moonlit Night" when there was no target available.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Companion Training" where, after mentoring a junior or guiding a senior, the training interface would display an unremovable notification (red dot) if there were unopened message alerts (red dots) prior to successfully completing the mentorship.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where "Evolve · Poverty God" could cause other opponent Shikigami to attach "Misfortune" even if it was defeated without having "Misfortune" attached.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Kaguya's "Five Puzzles" would fail to randomly select a card if the turn timed out during card selection.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Sakura's Reinforce card "Falling Petals" would not trigger its effect if an allied Shikigami was revived during the turn it entered the field.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where, under the scenario where your Sakura Yukihime's Field "Crimson Sakura" is active, your Yuki Onna's "Heart of Winter" has been used, and the first card played during your turn is Yuki Onna's "Graupel," the first "Snowball" generated by "Graupel" would not receive the Damage boost from "Heart of Winter."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the interface could not be closed properly when using the Zen Heart Ungaikyo to chain a card with the "Empower" effect granted by Hiyoribou · Sunny Blessing, and the turn timed out while in the Empower selection interface.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where using the chibi-style alternative art deck in Friend Duel would incorrectly display a blank square on the card face in the preparation interface.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the "Open All Packs" feature would only count one Secret Scroll towards Achievement statistics when opening multiple Secret Scrolls simultaneously.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: SE35 Approaches
notes.content: [p]Standard Ranked Match Balance Adjustments[/p][p]Evolve: Lucky Cat[/p][p]Before adjustment: Randomly add a Field card from your library with a level no higher than the current level of Fortune Cat to your hand, granting it Fast for this turn. Evolve: Once per turn, when you use a card from your hand, gain 2 Bounty.[/p][p]After Adjustment: Randomly place a Field card from the Library, with a level no greater than the current level of Lucky Cat, into the Hand. Evolve: Once per Turn, when your side uses a Combat card/Form card/other card from the Hand, gain 1 Bounty.[/p][p]Follow my command[/p][p]Before Adjustment: Choose one: Transfer the "Misfortune" attached to other Shikigami (excluding the God of Poverty) on the field to the God of Poverty; Fast Attach a "Misfortune" to the God of Poverty and draw a card.[/p][p]Adjusted: Choose one: Transfer the "Misfortune" attached to other Shikigami (excluding the God of Poverty) on the field to the God of Poverty; Fast The next die roll by the God of Poverty will always result in 1, and draw a card.[/p][p]Dragon Jade: Basic Ability[/p][p]Before Adjustment: Upon first upgrade and Revive, attach "Dragon Breath Power: Kun." Whenever Dragon Jade attaches "Dragon Breath Power: Qian," Projectile: Deal 2 points of Damage.[/p][p]After Adjustment: Upon first upgrade and Revive, attach "Dragon Breath Power: Kun." Whenever Dragon Jade attaches "Dragon Breath Power: Qian," Projectile: Deal 1 point of Damage.[/p][p]Catmobile[/p][p]Before Adjustment: Fast#rWhen another Shikigami in your Combat Zone is Defeated, Revive that Shikigami and attach a "Nine Lives" to Kyuumei Neko, then grant Kyuumei Neko 1 Attack Power and make it launch an Attack. This Attack is immune to Attack damage.[/p][p]After Adjustment: Fast#rWhen another Shikigami in your Combat Zone is Defeated, Revive that Shikigami and attach a "Nine Lives" to Kyuumei Neko, then make Kyuumei Neko launch an Attack. This Attack is immune to Attack damage.[/p][p]Night Parade of a Hundred Demons[/p][p]Before Adjustment: Attach a "Nine-Tailed Power" to Tamamonomae of the Blazing Heavens. Evolve: When Tamamonomae of the Blazing Heavens levels up, attach a "Nine-Tailed Power" to it. When Tamamonomae of the Blazing Heavens gains a "Nine-Tailed Power," randomly cast one of its origin Spells.[/p][p]Adjusted: Attach a "Nine-Tailed Power" to Tamamonomae of the Blazing Heavens. Evolve: When Tamamonomae of the Blazing Heavens levels up, attach a "Nine-Tailed Power" to it. Once per turn, when Tamamonomae of the Blazing Heavens gains a "Nine-Tailed Power," randomly cast one of its origin Spells.[/p][p]World-Ending Lotus[/p][p]Before Adjustment: Deal 4 points of Damage to the Opponent's Shikigami in the Combat Zone. Focus: Then deal 4 points of Damage to the Opponent Player.[/p][p]Adjusted: Deal 5 Damage to the Opponent's Shikigami in the Combat Zone. Focus: Additionally, deal 3 Damage to the Opponent Player.[/p][p]Snow Stream[/p][p]Before Adjustment: When dealing Damage to a Shikigami, attach "Frozen" to it. Whenever an Opponent's Shikigami gains "Frozen" or is Stunned, gain 1 Combat Power and 1 Shield.[/p][p]Adjusted: When dealing damage to a Shikigami, attach "Frozen" to it. Whenever an opponent's Shikigami is attached with "Frozen" or stunned, gain 1 battle power.[/p][p]Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on August 20, 2025. (Up to twice for each type)[/p][p]Shinkiro Summer Festival Pack Release Announcement[/p][p]· The Shinkiro Summer Festival Pack will be available after 00:00 on August 19, 2025. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.[/p][p]· The bundle includes Momo's chibi basic alternative art "Summer of Scorching Peach," Sakura's chibi basic alternative art "Dance of Sakura Tide," and Aobozu's chibi basic alternative art "Echo of Cicada."[/p][p]· Customers can purchase any single chibi basic card alternative art or choose a bundle of three chibi basic card alternative arts. Additionally, they can buy a discounted chibi alternative art combo pack that includes Secret Scrolls, Glass Stones, Refined Stones, or Ink Jade.[/p][p]· The "Summer Festival Selectable SSR Card Gift Box" will be available for a limited time starting at 0:00 on August 19, 2025. It contains one selectable SSR card. Each customer can purchase up to two times.[/p][p]· The "Summer Festival Selectable Shikigami Gift Box" will be available for a limited time starting at 0:00 on August 19, 2025. Customers can select one Shikigami and randomly receive 3 SR cards and 8 R cards of that Shikigami. Each customer can purchase up to two times.[/p][p]· The aforementioned pack will be removed at 24:00 on September 3, 2025.[/p][p]SE35 Approaches[/p][p]SE35 is about to start![/p][p]· At 00:00 on August 15, 2025, "Onmyoji: The Card Game" will welcome the SE35 season, featuring the Special Basic Card Alternative Art "Izanami - Radiant Rakshasa," the Avatar "Hakuzosu: Sharpened Will," the Transition Wallpaper "Storefront Renewal," the Permanent Battlefield Effect "Seal: Poverty God," and the Broadcast "Fortune Cat." Additional rewards include the Shiny Derivative Cards "Daruma: Bounty" and "Enmusubi: Omnius," as well as in-game expressions like "Otakemaru: Oath - Question," "Chiryu: Foodie," "Bukkuman: Aspiration - Recline," and three "Glass Card Frame: Basic." We warmly invite players to claim these exciting rewards![/p][p]· There is a higher chance of getting cards that you don't have yet when getting the SSR cards in the Tour Pass Rewards. If you've got all of them, then you'll have a higher chance of getting cards that you have fewer than 2 copies of.[/p][p]【Other Bug Fixes and Related Optimizations】[/p][p]· Fixed an error in the description of the Expert Pre-built Deck "Sun, Moon, and Stars."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Aoandon's "Ghost Stories" would cause the turn to end due to timeout when triggered repeatedly, preventing subsequent actions.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the Form "Gatekeeper" of Chen would fail to become immune to fatal damage caused by piercing Spell cards (e.g., Hououka's "Swaying Blaze").[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the card obtained by Tamamonomae through the Invocation "Nine-Tailed Power" could not be switched with other cards in the Hand when viewing details.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where, after using any Evolve card, opening the Shikigami details before the Evolve card's resolution would cause the Shikigami's card art to display as the Basic card art instead of the Evolved card art.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Secret Records" where the treasure "Dice Shield" would only enhance its effect by 1 point per battle.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Secret Records" where Komatsu's "Incoming Winter lv3" failed to grant Komatsu the keyword ability when the summoned "Delicious Pinecone" entered the field.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Deep Secrets of the Mirage" where using multiple "Pinecone Raid" cards could incorrectly apply damage and stun effects to the wrong target.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Secret Records" where the AI abilities "Soup Bowl Protection lv4" and "Soup Bowl Protection lv5" would remove two opponent cards when the player's side took damage.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Shinkiro Deep Secret Record" where the task reward for the Player "Yamausagi" and "Hakuro" mission "Complete 20 battles of difficulty level 1 or above" was mistakenly Ootengu Copper Coins.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Shinkiro Deep Secret Record" where the AI ability "Healing Melody" would trigger when Momiji's "Maple Teru Teru Bozu" was removed.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Deep Secrets of the Mirage" where the equipment "Luan Feng" would not function correctly when equipped by Shikigami other than Hououka.[/p][p]· Optimized the task completion condition in "Mirage Deep Secret Records" for the mission "Upgrade a player's card to level 3 during a match." Now, upgrading any Shikigami's card to level 3 will fulfill the requirement.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where, if Juzu used "Heart of Stone" while Charged and then used "Evolve: Juzu," "Heart of Stone" would fail to activate automatically when Juzu was attacked.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where "Evolve: Mitsume" could not obtain "Clue" if the Turn timed out while selecting "Clue."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where when the opponent's Shikigami Feng Yangjun was attached with the Invocation "Frozen" and then reattached with "Snow Flow," Feng Yangjun would cause damage again without removing "Frozen," but instead reapply "Frozen."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Kaoru-Yamakaze's Reinforce card "Feathered Shelter" would incorrectly trigger its effect when the allied Yamakaze attached with "Owl's Guard" was transformed into Guatai by the opponent's Karakuri "Guatai Transformation," causing the transformed Guatai to gain the Unyielding effect.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Data Pack "Alternation Omnius" Grand Launch
notes.content: [p]\[Data Pack "Alternation Omnius" Grand Launch][/p][p]The new Alternation Omnius data pack of Onmyoji: The Card Game is now available, featuring 7 new Shikigami.[/p][p]· Alternation Omnius Card Packs will be available after maintenance on July 17, 2025. [/p][p]· Includes 7 new Shikigami: Long Jue, Feng Yangjun, Nekomata: Radiant Banquet, Lucky Cat, Poverty God, Ember Tamamonomae, and Heart of Zen Ungaikyo.[/p][p]· After the Alternation Omnius data pack becomes available on July 17, guests will be able to claim 3 free Alternation Omnius Card Packs by logging into the game. [/p][p]· The Alternation Omnius Card Pack rebate event will be available after the maintenance on July 17, 2025 until 24:00 of August 6, 2025. During the event, when purchasing any 10 card packs with Jade, guests will get 1 free Alternation Omnius Card Pack, up to 5 packs.[/p][p]· The 7 Shikigami of the Alternation Omnius Card Pack are now all available.[/p][p]· New Reinforce cards will be added to the "Alternation Omnius" Card Packs in the future.[/p][p]【Adjustments Related to the "Alternation Omnius" Expansion】[/p][p]· Added the Master Collector title for the Alternation Omnius data pack. [/p][p]· Changed the requirement of the Supreme Collector title to collecting all cards of the 209 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included). [/p][p]· Changed the requirement of the Inked Heart title to collecting all Inked cards of the 209 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).[/p][p]· Changed the requirement of the Bright Glaze title to collecting all Glass Card Frames of the 209 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).[/p][p]· The Alternation Omnius Card Packs can now be purchased in the Hyakubun Scrollery.[/p][p]· Added 7 new Shikigami and Reinforce cards from the Alternation Omnius data pack to Sealed Deck. [/p][p]· The card pack rewards from Sealed Deck will include Alternation Omnius Card Packs. The random card rewards will include cards of the 7 new Shikigami and Reinforce cards from the Alternation Omnius data pack. [/p][p]· The rewards for Chapters 1, 2, and 3 of Kaidan will include cards of the 7 new Shikigami and Reinforce cards from the Alternation Omnius data pack.[/p][p]· The "Card Pack PYO Pack" item will allow the selection of Alternation Omnius Card Packs after the update on July 31, 2025.[/p][p]【"Alternation Omnius" Event Begins!】[/p][p]· Event Introduction:[/p][p]Guests can participate in the "Alternation Omnius" event by consuming "Secret Shards" to gradually unlock and explore new secret stories. Rewards include the Transition Wallpaper "Festival of Rebirth," Alternation Omnius Secret Scrolls, Ink Jade, Glass Stones, Tempered Stones, and more.[/p][p]· Event Time[/p][p]From after the maintenance on July 17, 2025, to 24:00 on July 30, 2025.[/p][p]· Specific Rules[/p][p]The event consists of 7 chapters, each containing several unlockable secret stories for guests.[/p][p]Collect "Secret Shards" to unlock the secrets in each chapter. Once all secrets in a chapter are unlocked, the next chapter will automatically open.[/p][p]Successfully unlocking a Secret will grant "Memory Crystals," and completing a Secret will reward "Secret Shards."[/p][p]During the event period, guests can claim 2 "Secret Shards" daily from the event interface; for each match victory, they can earn an additional 3 "Secret Shards," with a daily limit of 6 (limited to Ranked Match/Player Match/Sealed Deck/Investigation/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess). A daily first recharge of any amount will grant 2 "Secret Shards." The "Memory Crystal" items obtained during the event can be used to redeem various rewards, including exclusive Transition Wallpapers, Alternation Omnius Card Packs, Ink Jade, Glass Stone, and more. After the event ends, remaining "Secret Shards" and "Memory Crystals" will be converted into Daruma Coins at a certain ratio and sent via mail.[/p][p]【Alternation Omnius Expansion Pack Gift Box Now Available】[/p][p]· The "Alternation Omnius Welcome Pack" will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on July 17, 2025, containing 15 Alternation Omnius Card Packs.[/p][p]· The "Alternation Omnius Special Gift Box" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on July 17, 2026. The gift box contains 35 Alternation Omnius Secret Scrolls and a random Alternation Omnius SSR Card Gift Box.[/p][p]· The "Alternation Omnius Premium Selection Pack" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on July 17, 2025. The pack includes 50 Alternation Omnius Card Packs and a random Alternation Omnius SSR Card Pack.[/p][p]【Sealed Deck Mechanism Changes】[/p][p]· In the Sealed Deck mode, Reinforce cards are separated from the original SSR cards of Shikigami. Reinforce cards are considered a different rarity and have the same appearance rate as SSR cards, but they no longer occupy the guaranteed SSR card mechanism in the deck nor affect the appearance rate of the original SSR cards of Shikigami.[/p][p]· Reinforce cards can appear alongside SSR cards of Shikigami.[/p][p]· After selecting a Shikigami in Sealed Deck, the probability of the corresponding Reinforce Shikigami appearing has been slightly increased.[/p][p]Standard Ranked Match Balance Adjustments[/p][p]The following cards have been adjusted:[/p][p]Evolve: Oni Golden Sheep	[/p][p]Basic Stats: +0 Power/+1 Health --> +1 Power/+1 Health[/p][p]Before Adjustment: Steal 1 Power from an opponent's Shikigami until the start of your next turn. Evolve: The Power-stealing and card-stealing effects of Onikinyou are doubled. At the start of your turn, if there is no "Forewarning Letter" in your hand, gain a "Forewarning Letter."[/p][p]After Adjustment: Steal 1 Power from an opponent's Shikigami. Evolve: The steal effect of the Forewarning Letter is doubled. At the start of your turn, if you do not have a Forewarning Letter in your hand, gain 1 Forewarning Letter.[/p][p]The following cards have been enhanced:[/p][p]Fated Union	[/p][p]Before adjustment: Upon entering the field, gain 2 Bounty. At the start of your turn, gain 1 Bounty. After this Field is defeated, add a copy of this card to the Shop and lose this ability. Additionally, it will be guaranteed to appear in the next refresh.[/p][p]After Adjustment: Upon entering the field, gain 2 Bounty. At the start of your turn, gain 1 Bounty. When this Field is defeated, add a copy of this card to the Shop, lose this ability, and gain Fast. The next refresh will guarantee its appearance.[/p][p]Feast of Ancient Calamity	[/p][p]Before adjustment: Unique. When entering the battlefield, Stand Fast. Once every turn, when another Shikigami of yours is moved to the Combat Zone, transfer a Curse Veil from Magatsugami to that Shikigami. If this cannot be done, give that Shikigami +1 Power/+1 Health permanently.[/p][p]After Adjustment: Unique. When entering the battlefield, Stand Fast. Once every turn, when another Shikigami of yours is moved to the Combat Zone, transfer a Curse Veil from Magatsugami to that Shikigami and grant it 1 Shield. If this cannot be done, give that Shikigami +1 Power/+1 Health permanently.[/p][p]Evolve: Kinnara	[/p][p]Adjustment Before: Luck 6: Randomly put two cards of Kinnara into your hand. For every 2 Nightfall points you have, -1 point required for the Luck Check. Evolve: When Luck is triggered on Kinnara, randomly deal 3 damage to an opponent unit, Nightfall 10: Gain 1 Orb.[/p][p]After Adjustment: Randomly put 1 other card of Kinnara into your hand. Luck 6: Gain 1 more card. For every 2 Nightfall points you have, -1 point required for the Luck Check. Evolve: When Luck is triggered on Kinnara, randomly deal 3 damage to an opponent unit, Nightfall 10: Gain 1 Orb.[/p][p]Evolve: Okikumushi	[/p][p]Before Adjustment: Evolve: When a Poisoned Shikigami is defeated, deal 2 damage to the opponent player, and you recover 2 Health.[/p][p]Adjustment After: Projectile: Deal 2 points of poison damage. Evolve: When a poisoned opponent Shikigami is defeated, deal 2 damage to the opponent player and restore 2 health.[/p][p]Dark Remedy	[/p][p]Before Adjustment: Playable when defeated. Revive Sasori Onna, then Shelter.[/p][p]After Adjustment: Playable when defeated. Revive Sasori Onna, then Shelter. Enhance: If the opponent has a poisoned Shikigami, this card gains Fast.[/p][p]Sweet as the warm sunlight	[/p][p]Before adjustment: Fast#rGain 1 Delicacy card. If you gain 6 Delicacy cards in this game, all your Shikigami permanently gain 5 Power and 5 Health, and you recover 10 Health.[/p][p]After Adjustment: Fast#rGain 1 Delicacy card, and recover 4#\[生命]. If you gain 6 Delicacy cards in this game, all your Shikigami permanently gain 5#\[力量] and 5 Health, and you recover 10 Health.[/p][p]Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on July 23, 2025. (Up to twice for each type)	[/p][p]【Alternative Art Takes Turns to Discount: Twenty-ninth Turn Begins】[/p][p]· Many Alternative Arts which have been sold for over one year will enjoy a discount for a limited time during each turn, guests can head to the Alternative Art Shop to purchase them! [/p][p]· Event Time: From 10:00 on July 24, 2025, to 9:00 on September 11, 2025. [/p][p]· This round's alternative art: "Bukkuman·Summer Stroll Chronicles," "Tatsu·Gatekeeper," "Miketsu·Autumn Harvest," "Joruri Gozen·Joruri," "Hannya·Scent of Vengeance," "Ootengu·Lord of the Storm."[/p][p]Improvements and Bug Fixes[/p][p]· A new entry button for "Deep Secrets of the Mirage" has been added to the guest room, and the entrance to the "Deep Secrets of the Mirage" gameplay has been moved to the "Other Gameplay" section on the main page.[/p][p]· Optimized the position of the Shikigami avatar in the Reinforce card details interface during Player Matches to align with the position in the team formation interface.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where using Mannendake's "Everchanging Bamboo Shadow" to charge Viper Ning's "Twilight Crimson" did not correctly activate the effect of the charged "Twilight Crimson."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Record" where the Lingyou's "Treasure Dice" effect did not activate correctly.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Secret Records" where the effect of Spirit Blessing "Zashiki·Moon" did not activate correctly.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in the "Mirage Deep Secrets" where the effect of the Spirit Blessing "Hakuro·Sun" did not activate correctly.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Secret Records" where the effect of the powered-up Hakuro "Kai" did not activate correctly.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Record" where the enhanced Hakuro's "Protection" effect did not activate correctly.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Secret Records" where the effect of the powered-up Yamausagi "Protect Me" did not activate correctly.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Record" where the enhanced Yamausagi's "Cute is Justice" effect did not activate correctly.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Secret Records" where the entrance images for the stages "Tenacity Girl" and "Proud Poison Tongue" were incorrect.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Deep Secrets of the Mirage" where the boss Hana's deck contained incorrect cards.[/p][p]· Fixed a description issue in the player interface of the "Mirage Deep Secret Records" gameplay.[/p][p]· Fixed the issue where the treasure "Time's Chain Projectile" enhance effect was not working in the "Mirage Deep Secrets" gameplay.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Deep Secrets of the Mirage" where the Spirit Aid "Yamausagi: Moon" would not correctly trigger the basic ability of "Evolve: Yamausagi."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue in "Mirage Deep Record" where Komatsu's "Pinecone Raid lv2" and "Pinecone Raid lv3" effects did not trigger correctly.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the font size would become abnormally small when a Shikigami's Health reached two digits.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Hako Shoujo's "Brilliance" effect could prevent subsequent operations after use.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update announcements
notes.content: [p]【"Star Fate Strategies" Reinforce Card Grand Launch】[/p][p]· Six new Reinforce cards will be added to the "Starry Strategy" Secret Scrolls after maintenance on June 19, 2025. [/p][p]· After the Reinforce cards of the "Stellar Strategy" data pack become available on June 19, players can log into the game to claim 3 free Stellar Strategy Card Packs. [/p][p]· "Starbound Strategies Reinforce Card Welcome Pack" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025, containing 15 Starbound Strategies Card Packs.[/p][p]· The "Starry Strategy Reinforce Card Exclusive Gift Box" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025. The gift box contains 35 Starry Strategy Secret Scrolls and a random Starry Strategy SSR card gift box.[/p][p]· The "Stellar Strategy Reinforce Card Premium Gift Box" will be available at the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025. The gift box includes 50 Stellar Strategy Card Packs and a random Stellar Strategy SSR Card Gift Box.[/p][p]【Reinforce Card Acquisition Event - Dreaming of Flowers Begins】[/p][p]· Event Time: From 10:00 on June 19, 2025, to 24:00 on July 16, 2025.[/p][p]· Event Description:[/p][p]  During the event, players can claim 10 "Reinforce Points" daily from the event interface.[/p][p]  Players can earn an additional 10 "Reinforce Points" for each match victory, with a daily limit of 40 points (applicable to Ranked Match/Player Match/Card Match/Investigation Society/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess).[/p][p]  Players can earn 20 "Reinforce Points" by making their first recharge of any amount each day.[/p][p]  Accumulating "Reinforce Points" allows guests to obtain SSR Reinforce Cards, corresponding Shikigami SR cards, 14-day trial cards for the Shikigami, Starbound Strategies Card Packs, and other rewards on the event page.[/p][p]· Event Notice[/p][p]  Players can claim Reinforce Points on the event page after daily login. Each player can claim up to 10 points per day. The claimable Reinforce Points will refresh daily at 00:00. Please remember to claim your points in time.[/p][p]  Guests can earn 10 Reinforce Points each time they win in Ranked Match/Player Match/Game/Investigation Club/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess daily. Each guest can complete this task up to 4 times per day, and the task will refresh daily at 0:00.[/p][p]  Players will earn 20 Reinforce points for their first top-up of any amount each day, and the first top-up will reset at 00:00 daily.[/p][p]· The reward claim page will close along with the event page at 24:00 on July 16, 2025. Unclaimed rewards will be sent via mail.[/p][p]· Guests who did not obtain Reinforce cards during the event can still synthesize Reinforce cards later using Talismans.[/p][p]【Mirage Chronicles Gameplay Unlocked】[/p][p]· Permanent PVE Gameplay: Mirage Deep Records is now open! Guests can participate in the gameplay at Shotengai Sparrow.[/p][p]· In the Mirage Deep Record, players will take on the role of different Players as collectors of ghost stories, challenging various levels to gather ghost story information and complete the "Mirage Deep Record."[/p][p]· Guests, playing as the player, will use a fixed deck to take on challenges.[/p][p]· During each challenge, players will engage in several consecutive battles against AI decks. After each battle, players will restore all Health and receive deck enhancements.[/p][p]· Players will receive a certain number of Revive attempts during challenges, which can be used to retry the challenge upon failure.[/p][p]· Guests will receive a certain number of refresh attempts during challenges. When randomly refreshing selectable content, they can consume refresh attempts to re-roll options.[/p][p]Mechanic - Player Level[/p][p]· Players, as the role of the Player, will gain EXP based on challenge progress, allowing them to level up.[/p][p]· Upgraded players will unlock various abilities beneficial for subsequent challenges, including "Initial Stats Boost," "Initial Spirit Blessing," "Initial Treasure," "Initial Equipment," and "Card Upgrades."[/p][p]Mechanism - Equipment[/p][p]· "Equipment" is an item that can be equipped by Shikigami in the deck.[/p][p]· "Equipment" has various effects that activate when the equipped Shikigami meets certain conditions.[/p][p]· Players can obtain "Equipment" both inside and outside the challenges of the Mirage Deep Record.[/p][p]Mechanic - Card Upgrade[/p][p]· Players can upgrade all 32 cards of the 4 Shikigami in their deck, with each card having two upgrade levels. (Reinforce cards are not included.)[/p][p]· Players can obtain "Card Upgrades" both inside and outside the challenges of the Mirage Deep Record.[/p][p]Mechanism - Treasure[/p][p]· Players can obtain "Treasure" cards with various powerful effects both inside and outside challenges to enhance their deck strength.[/p][p]Mechanic - Spirit Blessing[/p][p]· Now, upon obtaining "Spiritual Aid," abilities are directly granted without relying on layer count for acquisition or upgrades.[/p][p]· Obtaining duplicate "Spiritual Aid" still allows for ability upgrades.[/p][p]· In the Mirage Chronicles, players can enhance their deck in various ways during combat breaks.[/p][p]Stages and Difficulty[/p][p]· As exploration progresses, the difficulty of the levels encountered by players will gradually increase.[/p][p]· Each level has five difficulty settings. Completing each difficulty will unlock ghost stories in the Mirage Deep Record.[/p][p]· Higher difficulty levels will result in opponents having more cards, stronger abilities, and certain initial value bonuses. Please prepare your player for cultivation accordingly.[/p][p]· Various content for the Mirage Deep Record gameplay will be continuously updated. Please look forward to future updates.[/p][p]Standard Ranked Match Balance Adjustments[/p][p]The following cards have been nerfed:[/p][p]Gathering Storm[/p][p]Before adjustment: In this turn, Ryomen gains 2 Power, 3 Shield, and Hunt. Enhance: Ryomen gains Haste when this card is linked to and used.[/p][p]Adjusted: In this turn, Ryomen gains 2 Power, 1 Shield, and Hunt. Enhance: Ryomen gains Haste when this card is linked to and used.[/p][p]The following cards have been enhanced:[/p][p]Wind Charm: Flash[/p][p]Before adjustment: This card will self-destruct at the end of the turn. Trigger: Automatically plays when Ichimokuren is attacked.[/p][p]Adjusted: Fast This card will self-destruct at the end of the turn. Trigger: Play automatically when Ichimokuren is attacked.[/p][p]Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on June 25, 2025. (Up to twice for each type)[/p][p]【Croak Chorus Avatar Frame Bundle Available】[/p][p]· Limited animated avatar frame "Frog Chorus" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on June 19, 2025. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time, ending at 24:00 on July 2. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.[/p][p]【Midsummer Night's Dream Card Back Bundle Available】[/p][p]· The limited dynamic Card Back "A Midsummer Night's Dream" will be available after the maintenance on June 19, 2025. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time. The limited-time discount will end at 24:00 on July 2. Players can go to the Jade Shop to purchase it.[/p][p]Appearances Return[/p][p]· The Special Basic Card Alternative Arts "Momo · Falling Blossoms - Peach Edition" and "Peacock King - Dance of Divine Prayer" return, and players can purchase them at the Jade Shop.[/p][p]· The Special Basic Card Alternative Art "Chen · Starry Path at Dusk" returns, and players can purchase it at the Jade Shop.[/p][p]· The Special Basic Card Alternative Art "Oitsuki·Water Moon·Eclipse Shadow Chase" returns. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.[/p][p]【Doodle Alternative Art Limited-time Return】[/p][p]· Return Time: From after maintenance on June 19, 2025, to 23:59 on July 2, 2025.[/p][p]· The returning Doodle Alternative Art includes: "Gomaru Doodle Alternative Art," "Kusa·Pupu Doodle Alternative Art," "Maestro Doodle Alternative Art," "Mouba Doodle Alternative Art," "Yamausagi Doodle Alternative Art," and "Kagewani Doodle Alternative Art"![/p][p]· For more details on the graffiti Alternative Art Card designs, players can refer to previous content~[/p][p]Improvements and Bug Fixes[/p][p]· When the synergy effect of battle cards can be triggered, the synergy keywords on the cards will be highlighted with a color change.[/p][p]· Adjusted the pacing of playing Spell cards and Combat cards. Now, when both sides play card effects, subsequent effects and actions will no longer be blocked.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where the game would freeze if the opponent's Library had no cards and Alena's Invocation was attached.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where defeating an opponent's Shikigami with the ability \[Self-Destruct When Injured] using damage from your side would not trigger your side's \[Defeat Effect]. For example: Saki "Four-Color Violet" and Ibaraki Doji "Rage Outlet."[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where Kusa·Urupu did not trigger the entry effect of Form Cards obtained through Zashiki \[Fortune's Favor].[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where players might be unable to close the Battlefield Shop interface after purchasing all items in the shop.[/p][p]· Fixed an issue where players purchasing cards consecutively in the battlefield shop and using Chiryu "Return to Void" before the cards were added to their hand would cause errors and affect subsequent settlements.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Shinkiro 5th Anniversary Thanksgiving Celebration
notes.content:
Shinkiro 5th Anniversary Thanksgiving Celebration Has Begun
Time flies, and Onmyoji: The Card Game is now celebrating its fifth anniversary with our guests! To express our gratitude for your continued support, we've prepared numerous exciting events and rewards for everyone!
Event Time: From after the maintenance on June 5, 2025 to 24:00 on June 18, 2025.

Phase 1: 5th Anniversary Sign-in Gifts!

· Event Time: From 10:00 on June 5, 2025, to 24:00 on June 18, 2025.
· Event Description: Players can get great rewards by logging in to the game every day during the event. Sign in for 7 days to get 3 Starry Strategies Card Packs, lots of Ink Jade, and Transition Wallpaper: Bold Declaration. 
· Must complete 7-Day Sign-in Gift Event to participate in this event.

Phase 2: May Championship Has Begun!
Event Time: From after the maintenance on June 5 to 24:00 on June 14.
Event Description:
This Baimon Tournament will have additional rules: Starting from Turn 13 (under no external influence, the turn when the first player upgrades to 3 Orbs), the base defeated countdown for all Shikigami changes to 2 until the end of the match (the countdown for already defeated Shikigami will not change).
· Guests can sign up for the Fine Moon Championship, pick their best deck, and compete with other guests for the championship.
· The event is divided into three stages: qualifiers, semi-finals, and finals.
Guests can register up to three times per day during the qualifier/semi-final stage. The first registration is free and subsequent registrations will each cost 10,000 Gold. Guests can register twice in total during the finals, both for free.
The deck selected cannot be modified after each registration. The challenge ends after winning 5 games or losing 2 games.
· Opening time:
Qualifiers: Open all day from after the maintenance on June 5, 2025 to 24:00 on June 8, 2025.
Semi-finals: Open all day from June 9, 2025, to 24:00 on June 12, 2025.
Finals: Open all day from June 13, 2025 to 24:00 on June 14, 2025.
· Guests can gain Gold and Random Card Packs based on the number of wins in each challenge. Players who advance to the semi-finals/finals will have a chance to get limited title Crowned Beauty, limited card back Bonded Meow, Random Card Packs, Glass Stones and more rewards!

Phase 3: Half-Price Card Crafting Limited Offer!
· Event Time: From after the maintenance on June 5, 2025, to 24:00 on June 18, 2025.
· During the event, each guest gets 3 chances to craft cards at half-price.
· Cards that can be crafted at half-price: All non-Alternative Art cards of all Shikigami from the Classic, Nightless Fire, Moonlit Fantasy, Slice Up the Sea, Fortune and Enmusubi, Four Guardians, Good or Evil, Flowers in Slumber, Fleeting Dreams, Noisy Cooking Battle, Paradise Chords, Interwoven Fates, Ethereal Essence, Thundering Awakening, Lantern Tales, Mortal Reincarnation, Peach Blossom Spring, Stellar Enlightenment, Twin Oblivion, and Thousand Records series.
· All guests who have purchased Advanced Techou in Kaidan Chapter 2 and claimed Stage 1 Reward to unlock Kyonshi Imoto can now craft Kyonshi Imoto's cards at half-price. 
· Guests who have collected 2 copies of all cards from the Classic, Nightless Fire, Moonlit Fantasy, Slice Up the Sea, Fortune and Enmusubi, Four Guardians, Good or Evil, Flowers in Slumber, Fleeting Dreams, Noisy Cooking Battle, Paradise Chords, Interwoven Fates, Ethereal Essence, Thundering Awakening, Lantern Tales, Mortal Reincarnation, Peach Blossom Homeland, Stellar Enlightenment, Twin Oblivion, Thousand Records of Sunny Poetry, Dragon Abyss Secret Realm, and Star Enmusubi series before 10:00 on June 5 will obtain a reward of 660 Glass Stones when logging in during the event.

Phase 4: Popular Shikigami Alternative Art Preview!
· "Crimson Crown Finale" and "Manor Feast" will be available in the Alternative Art Shop starting at 10:00 on June 5, 2025, with a limited-time discount. The discount event will end at 24:00 on June 18. Thank you for your support~

Phase 5: 5th Anniversary Limited-time Pack In Shop!
Limited-time sale duration: From after the maintenance on June 5, 2025 to 24:00 on June 18, 2025.
· The 5th Anniversary Celebration SSR Card Pack will be available in the Jade Shop from after the maintenance on June 5. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.
· The pack contains 1 PYO SSR card! Including:
Classic, Nightless Fire, Moonlit Fantasy, Slice Up the Sea, Fortune and Enmusubi, Four Guardians, Good or Evil, Flowers in Slumber, Fleeting Dreams, Noisy Cooking Battle, Paradise Chords, Interwoven Fates, Ethereal Essence, Thundering Awakening, Lantern Tales, Mortal Reincarnation, Home of Peach Blossom, Stellar Enlightenment, Twin Annihilation, Sunlit Poetry, Dragon Abyss Secret Realm, and Star Enmusubi series.

Phase 6: Boarding Benefits
· From June 5 to June 7, obtain Random Card Pack x1 via mail upon boarding every day.

Standard Ranked Match Balance Changes

Mask of Reincarnation	
Before Adjustment: Veiled When Menreiki's faction changes to Blue Mist, deal 1 damage to all opponent Shikigami.
Adjusted: Veiled When Menreiki's faction changes to Blue Mist, deal 1 damage to two random opponent Shikigami.

Stellar Hunt	
Before the Adjustment: Hunt, Enhance: If you have entered Enlightenment this turn, this card gains Speedy.
After Adjustment: Hunt

Sanming Liutong	Random Effect
Before the Adjustment: +2 Power
After the Adjustment: Gain 1 Power and 1 Shield.

Today's Quest (Thursday)	
Before Adjustment: Condition: Usable after 4 cards that are not in your deck have been played (this card is effective in the library). Fast. Deal 5 damage to an opponent unit.
Adjusted: Condition: Usable after 4 cards that are not in your deck have been played (this card is effective in the library). Fast Deal 4 damage to an opponent unit.

Inexhaustible Ink	
Before Adjustment: Base Stats: 3 Power, 3 Health
Adjusted: Base Stats: 3 Power, 2 Health

All or Nothing	
Before Adjustment: "Cost Control" gains "Projectile: Deal 2 damage." Evolve: Haste During your turn, whenever Tesso deals combat damage, gain 2 "Cost Control" cards.
After the Adjustment: "Cost Control" gains "Projectile: Deal 1 damage." Evolve: Haste Whenever Tesso deals combat damage during your turn, gain 2 "Cost Control" cards.

Higanbana Returns
Before Adjustment: Divination 2 when this card is played.#rYou can play the top card in the library as a card in your hand. When you play cards in this way, you take 2 damage.#rThe Level 1 top card in your library will not cost any Orbs.
After Adjustment: Divination 4 when this card is played.#rYou can play the top card in the library as a card in your hand. When you play cards in this way, you take 2 damage.#rThe Level 1 top card in your library will not cost any Orbs.

Road of Firelight	
Before Adjustment: Level 1 cards in your hand gain Fast and make you take 1 damage when the card is played.
Adjusted: Level 1 cards in your hand and library gain Fast and make you take 1 damage when the card is played.

Evolve: Kuro Mujou
Before Adjustment: When entering the battlefield, attach Soul Seizing to an opponent Shikigami. Soul Seizing additionally causes your other Shikigami to be only able to attack Shikigami in the Combat Zone and Shikigami attached with Soul Seizing.#rEvolve: When a Shikigami of yours defeats a Shikigami in combat, it permanently gains +1#[力量].

notes.title: Update announcements
notes.content:

【Featured Card Pack VIII Soon Available in Hyakubun Scrollery】 
· Available Time: From after the maintenance on May 22, 2025. 
· Featured Card Pack VIII includes Reinforce cards and Shikigami that work well with them (Reinforce cards can be drawn). If you need to strengthen your deck, head to the Hyakubun Scrollery to purchase them.
· "Selected Secret Scroll Vol. VIII" includes Shikigami: Shuten Doji, Ibaraki Doji, Chin, Itsumade, Hououka, Aoandon, Yamausagi, Zashiki, Menreiki, Aoandon: Wildfire, Susabi: Awakening, Ame Onna, Thieving God, Enenra: Ethereal, Cat River, and Youning.

· The "Featured Card Pack VIII Special Gift Box" will be available in the Jade Shop after the maintenance on May 22, 2025. The gift box contains 35 Featured Card Pack VIII cards and one random SSR Shikigami card from Featured Card Pack VIII (including Reinforce cards). The price is 790 Jade.
· The "Featured Card Pack VIII Premium Gift Box" will be available in the Jade Shop after the maintenance on May 22, 2025. The gift box contains 50 Featured Card Pack VIII cards and one random SSR Shikigami card from Featured Card Pack VIII (including Reinforce cards). The price is 1030 Jade.

【Exclusive Player Match Event - Bounty Frenzy Begins】
· Event Time: From 10:00 on May 22, 2025, to 24:00 on May 28, 2025.
· During the event, all Decks gain enhanced bounty rewards in the "Sealed Deck" Player Match.
· At the start of the match, the player will receive 2 additional cards: one "Universal Bounty" and one "Exclusive Bounty." The "Universal Bounty" grants a bounty bonus to the player (choose 1 out of 4 fixed abilities), while the "Exclusive Bounty" enables one Shikigami in the deck to gain the ability to earn bounties during the game (the method of earning bounties varies by Shikigami, and the bonus effect of the "Exclusive Bounty" applies only to that Shikigami).
· During the event, the Shop gains an additional effect: At the start of the game, the SSR of the current deck's Shikigami will be added to the Shop and can be purchased using bounties.
· During the event, the Shop gains additional effects: At the start of the game, extra Shop cards are unlocked for purchase based on the player's current Deck. Each Shikigami unlocks 2 different Shop cards, and different Shikigami may unlock the same Shop cards (in such cases, the purchase quantity will not stack).
· During the event, each customer gets 2 chances for free entry.
· There are 16 bounty acquisition methods for Shikigami and 30 new Shop cards for players to explore.
· At the start and end of this event, guests' game process in Sealed Deck will be settled, and rewards will be issued according to the wins with Jikikaeru Ticket x15 as compensation. Guests who have not logged in to the game during the event period will not be affected.

【Reinforce Card Acquisition Event - Finding Kindred Spirits in the Wind Begins】
· Event Time: From 10:00 on May 22, 2025, to 24:00 on June 18, 2025.
· Event Description:
  During the event, players can claim 10 points of "Reinforce Points" daily on the event interface.
  Each victory in a match grants an additional 10 "Reinforce Points," with a daily limit of 40 points (applicable to Ranked Match/Player Match/Card Match/Investigation Club/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess).
  Daily first recharge of any amount grants 20 Reinforce Points.
  Accumulate "Reinforce Points" to obtain SSR Reinforce Cards, corresponding Shikigami SR Cards, 14-day Trial Cards for the Shikigami, Starry Strategy Secret Scrolls, and other rewards on the event page.
· Event Notice
  Players can claim Reinforce Points on the event page after daily login, with a maximum of 10 points per day. The claimable Reinforce Points will refresh daily at 00:00. Please remember to claim your points in time.
  Players can earn 10 Reinforce points for each victory in Ranked Match/Player Match/Card Match/Investigation Society/Shotengai Combat/Hyakubun Chess daily. Each player can complete this task up to 4 times per day, and the task resets at midnight daily.
  Players can earn 20 Reinforce Points with their first recharge of any amount each day. The first recharge will also refresh daily at 00:00.
· The reward claim page will close along with the event page at 24:00 on June 18, 2025. Unclaimed rewards will be sent via mail.
· Players who did not obtain the Reinforce cards during the event can still synthesize them later using Talismans.
· Melody of the Wind cannot be drawn from the card pool during the event period
Appearances Return

· Fixed an issue where Hakuzosu · Sharpened Heart's "Foxflame · Azure" Shikigami might experience abnormal damage calculation after using a Form Card.

The following cards have been enhanced:

Maintenance Time
Add an option during Assault: Lazy Guwa
Moyu Frog: If there is no Guaduo Momentum in the Combat Zone, randomly summon a Guatai, then grant the summoned entity of Onikage the effect "Self-destruct upon taking damage," and restore 2 Health to Onikage.

Gua Cleansing

After the adjustment: If there is no Gua Duo Power in the Combat Zone, randomly Summon a Gua Tai, then have the summoned entity of Onro use its exclusive card, causing Onro to take 2 damage.

Before Adjustment: Whenever you use a stack card from your hand, Luck 4: Use another stack card of the same quantity.
Adjusted: Whenever you use a stack card from your hand, Luck 4: Use another stack card of the same quantity. For every 3 Shop cards you use during this game, the required Luck points decrease by 1.

Delion's Promise

Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+0 Health
After the adjustment: Basic boost: +0 Power/+1 Health

Evolve: Kusa
Before the adjustment: When entering the battlefield, trigger Kusa's entering effect of her current form. Evolve: When Kusa uses a different Form Card from her current form, trigger the entering effect of the current form and draw a card.
After the adjustment: When entering the battlefield, trigger Kusa's entering effect of her current form. Evolve: When Kusa uses a Form Card, trigger the entering effect of the current form and draw a card.

Izuna Pact	
Before the adjustment: Reduce Kanko's Countdown by 2.
After the Adjustment: Attach a Vengeful Fox Mark to Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone and reduce Kanko's countdown by 2.

Divine Flames of Wrath	
Before the Adjustment: Each of your "Serpent Demons" launches an attack and becomes immune to attack damage.
After the Adjustment: Each of your "Serpent Demons" launches an attack, gains 1 Power, and becomes immune to attack damage.

Wrath of Unwillingness	
Before the Adjustment: Basic boost: +1 Power/+0 Shield
After the adjustment: Basic boost: +2 Power/+0 Shield

Night of Fear	
Before Adjustment: When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, attach Fear to a random opponent Shikigami that is not attached with Fear, and gain 1 Wing of Fear. Wing of Fear is playable when defeated, and can be played on your other Shikigami.
After the adjustment: Upon entering and at the start of your turn, bind "Fear" to a random opponent's Shikigami that is not already bound with "Fear" and gain two "Fear Wings." "Fear Wings" can be used upon being defeated and can target other allied Shikigami. Once per turn, each use of "Fear Wings" on Ten Gyaku increases its effect by 1.

Ace Commander	
Before the Adjustment: During your turn, when your Shikigami uses a Blessing Card or Burst Card, Taki gains Haste, Exaltation, and Barrier. Blessing 3: Taki gains Haste and Exaltation.
Adjusted: When entering the battlefield and when your Shikigami uses a Blessing card or Burst card during your turn, Taki gains Haste, Inspiration, and Barrier. Blessing 3: Taki gains Haste and Inspiration.

Evolve: Chi Li	
Before the adjustment: Discard a card and draw a card. Evolve: Once every turn, when you discard a card, Chi Li charges a matching faction's Flowing Cloud.
After Adjustment: Discard a card and draw two cards. Evolve: Once every turn, when you discard a card, Chi Li charges a matching faction's Flowing Cloud.

Enmusubi of All Things	
Before the Adjustment: Upon entering, randomly add a "Enmusubi Card" to the Shop and attach "Fortune Enmusubi," ensuring it appears in the next refresh. At the start of your Turn, increase the effect of all "Enmusubi Cards" by 1.
After the Adjustment: Upon entering, randomly add an unused "Enmusubi Card" to the Shop and attach "Fortune Enmusubi," ensuring it appears in the next refresh. At the start of your Turn, increase the effect of all "Enmusubi Cards" by 1.

Blessing 4: Restore 4 Health to yourself. Blessing 4: Divine 1, draw a card. Blessing 4: Randomly deal 4 Damage to an opponent's Shikigami. Blessing 4: Inflict 4 Fragile on the opponent Player.

· Fixed an issue where Shuten Doji/Ibaraki Doji's Reinforce Card "Frenzied Song and Heroic Spirit" would not trigger the effect of "Evolve: Mio."

notes.title: Starbound Strategies expansion is now live
notes.content:
Starbound Strategies expansion is now live
The new Starry Fate data pack of Onmyoji: The Card Game is now available, featuring 6 new Shikigami.
· Starry Fate Card Packs will be available after the maintenance on April 24, 2025. 
· Includes six new Shikigami: Oni Kinyou, Oboroguruma, Enmusubi: Fulfillment, Hakuzosu: Grind Heart, Itsumade: Thousand Seek, Tesso: Wealthy Merchant, and four Reinforce cards.
· After the new Star Fate Strategies data pack becomes available on April 24, guests will be able to claim 3 free Star Fate Strategies Card Packs by logging into the game. 
· The Starbound Strategies Card Pack rebate event will be available after the maintenance on April 24, 2025 until 24:00 of May 7, 2025. During the event, when purchasing any 10 card packs with Jade, guests will get 1 free Starbound Strategies Card Pack, up to 5 packs.

Adjustments related to the Starbound Strategies expansion
· Added the Master Collector title for the Starry Fate data pack. 
· Changed the requirement of the Supreme Collector title to collecting all cards of the 202 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included). 
· Changed the requirement of the Inked Heart title to collecting all Inked cards of the 202 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· Changed the requirement of the Bright Glaze title to collecting all Glass Card Frames of the 202 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· The Starbound Strategies Card Packs can now be purchased in the Hyakubun Scrollery.
· Added 6 new Shikigami and Reinforce cards from the Starry Fate data pack to Sealed Deck. 
· The card pack rewards from Sealed Deck will include Star Fate Strategies Card Packs. The random card rewards will include cards of the 6 new Shikigami from the Star Fate Strategies data pack. 
· The rewards of Kaidan Chapter 1, 2 & 3 will include cards of the 6 new Shikigami from the Star Destiny Strategies data pack.


【"Shotengai Secrets" event is now live!】
Event Introduction:
· During the "Shotengai Secrets" event, guests can use "Secret Shards" to gradually unlock and explore new secret stories, and win rewards such as the Transition Wallpaper "Enmusubi All Things", Star Enmusubi Secret Scrolls, Ink Jade, Glass Stone, and Refined Stone.
Event Time:
· From after the maintenance on April 24, 2025 to 24:00 on May 7, 2025.
Specific rules:
· The event consists of 7 chapters, each containing several secret stories for guests to unlock.
· Collect "Secret Shards" to unlock secrets in chapters. Once all secrets in a chapter are unlocked, the next chapter will automatically open.
· In this event, there is a special stage called Guatai Maze. In this stage, guests do not need to engage in combat. Eight Guatai will disguise themselves as 8 random card images. Guests will have the names of these 8 cards and need to match the cards in their hand with the corresponding card images to identify the disguised Guatai. Note that if you fail to identify correctly, the Player will take damage from Guatai. Successfully identifying all Guatai will clear the stage.
· After completing all chapters of the event, you can also enter the Guatai Maze from the event entrance to play.


【Star Fate Strategies Data Pack Gift Box Optimization】
· Overall discounts on all data pack gift boxes have been increased.
· The Starbound Strategies Welcome Gift Box will be available in the Jade Shop after the maintenance on April 24, 2025. The gift box contains 15 Starbound Strategies Card Packs (previously 10 packs). The price has been adjusted to 240 Jade (previously 265 Jade).
· The "Star Destiny Strategies Special Gift Box" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on April 24, 2025. The gift box includes 35 Star Destiny Strategies Secret Scrolls (previously 30) and a random SSR card gift box from Star Destiny Strategies. The price remains unchanged.
· The "Star Enmusubi Premium Gift Box" will be available in the Jade Shop after maintenance on April 24, 2025. The gift box contains 50 Star Enmusubi Secret Scrolls and a random Star Enmusubi SSR Card Gift Box. Price: 1090 Jade
· Added the "Star Destiny Strategies" Blooming Gift Box, which allows you to choose a Shikigami from the Star Destiny Strategies data pack (including Reinforce cards) and obtain one SSR card of that Shikigami. The gift box will be removed from sale at 24:00 on May 24, 2025. Price: 60 Jade.

· Fixed an issue where when our Jorogumo attaches to the Spider Oni Hime, and the Opponent's Kyonshi Ani is present with the Gathering Evil Formation attached, after our side defeats the Opponent's Shikigami in the Combat Zone, triggering the Opponent's Kyonshi Ani's Countdown to end and launch an assault, causing our Shikigami in the Combat Zone to be defeated, it would not trigger our Spider Oni Hime to summon a spider swarm.

· Fixed an issue where after Evolve Kanihime copied Evolve Mitsume's card, using the copied card would cause the game to freeze.
· Fixed an issue where when Sea's Blessing is present, our Shikigami leveling up would not grant cards.
· Fixed an issue where when Gatekeeper is present and Chen has Tenacity, after attaching Crane's Guard, receiving non-lethal damage from the Opponent would trigger the immune damage effect.
· Fixed an issue where the Demon Parade would record the damage dealt in previous turns.
· Fixed an issue where when there are 2 Divine Cuisine cards on the Field, only one copy would be made when the Field effect is Triggered.
· Fixed the issue where the Kanihime-copied [Today's Quest] Card could not be used.
· Fixed an issue where Dodomeki's basic ability to deal Projectile damage was not triggered when Kisei's basic ability to Divine was activated by Godly Move.
· Fixed the issue where some extra interface effects would time out and end the Turn when players opened the extra interface, causing the corresponding Card effects to loop incorrectly.
· Fixed an issue where the text for the Deck victory conditions was incorrect on the mentor's Deck upload screen.
· Fixed an issue with the total progress display of the Talisman tasks between Shou and Kisei in the shop.
· Fixed an issue where Decks could not be shared through friends and world chat.
· Fixed an issue where if Oni Kinyou is Defeated by Damage during the resolution of Oni Kinyou's Oni's Astonishing Surprise Trigger, the end of Turn effect would not activate.
· Fixed the issue where Ibaraki Doji's Form "Rage Outlet" could not trigger the "Hellfire" effect when defeating an Opponent's Shikigami in the Standby Zone.
· Fixed the issue where Tsukuyomi's "Planet" would not grant the Opponent Player the "False Moon" after placing the Opponent's Hand into the Enlightenment Zone.
· Fixed the issue where the description of the Player Match special effect item "Player Match: Chi Seal" was incorrect.
· Fixed the issue where a standard Deck with two identical Reinforce cards could be converted to an unlimited Deck and then have additional identical Reinforce cards added.
· Fixed an issue where Shikigami with the Substitute ability would remove the Invocation effects of Karasu Tengu's "Divine Power" and "Weakness" when the Substitute effect was triggered.
· Fixed the issue where Hakuzosu's Blazing Pupil Invocation "Foxfire: Blue" effect would not activate in certain situations.
For example: the damage caused by cards like Ootengu's "Lord of the Storm" and Maestro's "Evolve: Entry".
· Fixed an issue in the Endless Chapter of the Shou and Kisei's Shop where after using the Thief God's Treasure while Shapeshifting Youkai is in Hand, Shapeshifting Youkai would incorrectly transform into a Thief God Shikigami card.
· Fixed the issue where using Blazing Pupil would prevent the Bukkuman Invocation counter from increasing.
· Fixed an issue where using the Four Dots Alternative Art to attach Zashiki to Yoto Hime's Blade Curse would revert to the original effect after Yoto Hime transformed using an Evolve card.

· Fixed an issue where when our Jorogumo attaches to the Spider Oni Hime, and the Opponent's Kyonshi Ani is present with the Gathering Evil Formation attached, after our side defeats the Opponent's Shikigami in the Combat Zone, triggering the Opponent's Kyonshi Ani's Countdown to end and launch an assault, causing our Shikigami in the Combat Zone to be defeated, it would not trigger our Spider Oni Hime to summon a spider swarm.
· Fixed an issue where when Drunk and Full is on the Field, Stunning the opponent's Okikumushi would cause the opponent to discard a Sasori Onna card during their Turn.
· Fixed an issue where Culinary Investigation could not use Pre-made Delicacies.
· Fixed an issue where items in the Shop would get stuck on the interface if the Shop was accessed at the same time the turn automatically ended.
· Fixed an issue where when Withering Forest is on the Field, the effect of the Misfortune God's Invocation could be Triggered after the Field deals Damage during the player's Turn.
· Fixed an issue where when both Awakened Nekokawa and Fujiwara Merchant are present and the opponent's Moonlit Banquet is also present, Tsukuyomi using Lies would cause the player to gain the maximum number of False Moon cards in their Hand.
· Fixed an issue where after Evolve Kanihime copied Evolve Mitsume's card, using the copied card would cause the game to freeze.
· Fixed an issue where when Sea's Blessing is present, our Shikigami leveling up would not grant cards.
· Fixed an issue where when Gatekeeper is present and Chen has Tenacity, after attaching Crane's Guard, receiving non-lethal damage from the Opponent would trigger the immune damage effect.
· Fixed an issue where the Demon Parade would record the damage dealt in previous turns.
· Fixed an issue where when there are 2 Divine Cuisine cards on the Field, only one copy would be made when the Field effect is Triggered.
· Fixed the issue where the Kanihime-copied [Today's Quest] Card could not be used.
· Fixed an issue where Dodomeki's basic ability to deal Projectile damage was not triggered when Kisei's basic ability to Divine was activated by Godly Move.
· Fixed the issue where some extra interface effects would time out and end the Turn when players opened the extra interface, causing the corresponding Card effects to loop incorrectly.
· Fixed an issue where the text for the Deck victory conditions was incorrect on the mentor's Deck upload screen.
· Fixed an issue with the total progress display of the Talisman tasks between Shou and Kisei in the shop.
· Fixed an issue where Decks could not be shared through friends and world chat.
· Fixed an issue where if Oni Kinyou is Defeated by Damage during the resolution of Oni Kinyou's Oni's Astonishing Surprise Trigger, the end of Turn effect would not activate.
· Fixed the issue where Ibaraki Doji's Form "Rage Outlet" could not trigger the "Hellfire" effect when defeating an Opponent's Shikigami in the Standby Zone.
· Fixed the issue where Tsukuyomi's "Planet" would not grant the Opponent Player the "False Moon" after placing the Opponent's Hand into the Enlightenment Zone.
· Fixed the issue where the description of the Player Match special effect item "Player Match: Chi Seal" was incorrect.
· Fixed the issue where a standard Deck with two identical Reinforce cards could be converted to an unlimited Deck and then have additional identical Reinforce cards added.
· Fixed an issue where Shikigami with the Substitute ability would remove the Invocation effects of Karasu Tengu's "Divine Power" and "Weakness" when the Substitute effect was triggered.
· Fixed the issue where Hakuzosu's Blazing Pupil Invocation "Foxfire: Blue" effect would not activate in certain situations.
For example: the damage caused by cards like Ootengu's "Lord of the Storm" and Maestro's "Evolve: Entry".
· Fixed an issue in the Endless Chapter of the Shou and Kisei's Shop where after using the Thief God's Treasure while Shapeshifting Youkai is in Hand, Shapeshifting Youkai would incorrectly transform into a Thief God Shikigami card.
· Fixed the issue where using Blazing Pupil would prevent the Bukkuman Invocation counter from increasing.
· Fixed an issue where using the Four Dots Alternative Art to attach Zashiki to Yoto Hime's Blade Curse would revert to the original effect after Yoto Hime transformed using an Evolve card.
