notes.title: Update Announcements
notes.content:
Kisaragi Championship Has Begun!
· Event Time: From after the maintenance on February 27, 2025 to 24:00 on March 8, 2025.
Event Description:
· Guests can sign up for the Shinki Championship, pick their best deck, and compete with other guests for the championship.
· Special rules for combat in this event: Starting from Turn 13 (the turn when the first player gets an extra upgrade), the base defeat countdown for all Shikigami changes to 2 until the end of the match (the countdown for already defeated Shikigami will not change).
· The event is divided into three stages: qualifiers, semi-finals, and finals.
Guests can register up to three times per day during the qualifier/semi-final stage. The first registration is free and subsequent registrations will each cost 10,000 Gold. Guests can register twice in total during the finals, both for free.
The deck selected cannot be modified after each registration. The challenge ends after winning 5 games or losing 2 games.
· Opening time: 
Qualifiers: Open all day from after the maintenance on February 27, 2025 to 24:00 on March 2, 2025.
Semi-finals: Open all day from March 3, 2025 to 24:00 on March 6, 2025.
Finals: Open all day from March 7, 2025 to 24:00 on March 8, 2025. 
· Guests can gain Gold and Random Card Packs based on the number of wins in each challenge. Guests who advance to the semi-finals/finals will have a chance to get Limited Title - Kisaragi's Triumph, Kisaragi's Triumph: SSR, Limited Card Back - Cloud Crane Golden Feather, Random Card Packs, Glass Card Frame: Basic, Ink Jade, Glass Stone and more rewards!

Featured Card Pack VII Soon Available in Hyakubun Scrollery 
· Available Time: From after the maintenance on February 27, 2025. 
· Featured Card Pack VII contains recently enhanced Shikigami and Shikigami who work well with them. If you need to strengthen your deck, head to the Hyakubun Scrollery to get yours!
· Featured Card Pack VII contains: Ichimokuren, Yamakaze, Kisei, Sugar Worker, Gomaru, Garei, Wuchen, Mannendake, Ootengu: Steel Storm, Aobozu: Mundane Life, Emyoudou, Ubume: Tamayura, Momo: Hafubuki, Amaterasu, Izanami, Menreiki: Heart.
· Featured Card Pack VI will be removed from Hyakubun Scrollery after the maintenance on February 27, 2025.

Standard Ranked Match Balance Adjustments
The following cards have been enhanced:

River Spy	
Before the Adjustment: Divination 3, draw 1 card.
Adjusted: Divination 3, draw 1 card. Enhance: Gain Fast during this turn if your Luck Check is successful.

Evolve: Kappa	
Before Adjustment: Evolve: Once per turn, if your Luck Check is successful during your turn, Divination 1 and draw a card.
Adjusted: Luck 4: Restore 3 [Health] to you. Evolve: Once per turn, if your Luck Check is successful during your turn, Divination 1 and draw a card.

Puppet Master	
Before the Adjustment: When Matsu attacks, make the Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone attack the opponent player.
Adjusted: When Matsu attacks, make the Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone attack the opponent player. Enhance: If there is a Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone, Matsu gains Haste during this turn.

Evolve: Matsu	
Before Adjustment: Evolve: When Matsu uses a card, link to 1 card of each undefeated Shikigami.
Adjusted: When using this card, link to 1 card of each undefeated Shikigami. Evolve: When Matsu uses a card, link to 1 card of each undefeated Shikigami.

Servitor
Adjust Part I: None Effect
After the Adjustment: Your Fujihime has Veiled.

Evolve: Suzuhiko Hime
Before Adjustment: Permanently give 2 Power to Suzuhiko Hime, and play an extra Evolve: Sacred Scorching Fire. Evolve: When Suzuhiko Hime is defeated, switch to Sacred Scorching Fire with 1 Health and move to the Standby Zone.
Adjusted: Permanently give 2 Power to Suzuhiko Hime, recover 3 Health, and play an extra Evolve: Sacred Scorching Fire. Evolve: When Suzuhiko Hime is defeated, switch to Sacred Scorching Fire with 1 Health and move to the Standby Zone.

Mask of Reincarnation	
Before the Adjustment: At the start of your turn, randomly change Menreiki to another faction.
After the Adjustment: Upon entering and at the start of your turn, randomly change Menreiki to another faction.

Evolve: Kamaitachi	
Before Adjustment: Evolve: Charge. Gain 1 Energy when Kamaitachi deals damage to the player. Kamaitachi can use 3 Energy to Assault when you have no Orbs or Assault attempts.
Adjusted: Evolve: Charge. Gain 1 Energy when Kamaitachi deals damage to the player. Kamaitachi can use 3 Energy to Assault and gain 1 Power when you have no Orbs or Assault attempts.

Shiro Mujou 
Basic	
Before the Adjustment: Countdown 3: Switch to Kuro Mujou. 
After the Adjustment: Countdown 2: Switch to Kuro Mujou.

Evolve: Tomato	
Before Adjustment: Randomly place one of Kyonshi Imoto's Combat Cards into your hand. Evolve: Replace Kyonshi Imoto with Tomato and replace her Non-combat cards with random Combat cards.
Adjusted: Randomly place two of Kyonshi Imoto's Combat Cards on your hand. Evolve: Replace Kyonshi Imoto with Tomato and replace her Non-combat cards with random Combat cards.

Kanihime
Before Adjustment: Kanihime's cards in your hand gain Fast if a card that has the same name as it has been played in this game.
Adjusted: Kanihime's cards in your hand and Enlightenment Zone gain Fast if a card that has the same name as it has been played in this game.

Dreams Have Everything
Before the Adjustment: At the end of your turn, randomly place a copy of a card in your hand into your hand.
Adjusted: When entering the battlefield, draw a card of Kanihime. At the end of your turn, randomly place a copy of a card in your hand into your hand.

Voidness Fire	
Before Adjustment: Once per turn, when your Shikigami assaults or uses a combat card, Nightfall 10: Gain 2 Power. At the end of your turn, gain a random combat card you have used in this match.
Adjusted: Each effect can be triggered once per turn. When your Shikigami assaults or uses a combat card, Nightfall 10: Gain 2 Power. At the end of your turn, gain a random combat card you have used in this match.

Incense Field	
Before Adjustment: Etch when entering the battlefield. When the opponent player's card in hand is Etched, Dominate: Gain 1[Weak] and 1[Fragile].
Adjusted: Etch when entering the battlefield. When the opponent player's card in hand is Etched or after using an Etched card, Dominate: Gain 1[Weak] and 1[Fragile].

Evolve: Puppeteer	
Before Adjustment: Place 1 random card of Puppeteer's Form Cards into your hand. Evolve: Puppeteer permanently attach the Evolve: Puppetry form.
Adjusted: Choose 1 Puppeteer's Form Card to place into your hand. Evolve: Puppeteer permanently attach the Evolve: Puppetry form.

The following cards have been adjusted and nerfed

Thunder Fury	
Before the Adjustment: Basic boost +1 Power/+1 Shield
After the Adjustment: Basic boost +0 Power/+1 Shield

Galloping Dragon	
Before Adjustment: Deal damage equal to Chi Li's [Power] to Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone. Draw 1 card and deal 3 damage to Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone when this card is discarded.
Adjusted: Deal damage equal to Chi Li's [Power] to Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone. Draw 1 card and deal 2 damage to Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone when this card is discarded.

notes.title: Update announcements
notes.content:
[Shotengai Challenge: Endless Chapter Start]
· Shotengai resident mode: Shotengai Challenge - Endless Chapter is now available! Guests can sign up for matches at Sparrow in the Shotengai.
· In the Shotengai Challenge: Endless Chapter, each challenge has 5 stages. Successfully complete all 5 stages to clear the challenge and claim victory for the deck. However, a single stage failed during the challenge will result in overall failure.
· In the Endless Chapter of the Shotengai Challenge, a new Spirit Blessing system has been added.
After completing stages 1 to 4 in each challenge, guests will have a chance to choose a Spirit Blessing.
Lingyou has different entries, and accumulating the same entry to a certain level can provide ability bonuses for this challenge.
In each challenge, you can equip up to three Spirit Blessings. When you obtain more than the limit, you must choose one to replace an equipped Spirit Blessing.
· In the Shotengai Challenge: Endless Chapter, difficulty levels have been added. There are three difficulty levels for guests to choose from, and the AI deck will randomly carry a different number of skills depending on the difficulty.
· In the Shotengai Challenge: Endless Chapter, by challenging different difficulties, accumulating entries, and obtaining spirit blessings of different rarities, you can complete challenge quests and earn rewards such as Gold, Patterns, and Glass Stones.
· The content of the Shotengai Challenge will continue to be updated, stay tuned for more.

[Spring Festival Blessing Lucky Bag Event Starts!]
· Event Time: From after the maintenance on February 13, 2025 to 24:00 on February 26, 2025.
· During the event, guests can spend 1 Daruma Token or 60 Jade to draw a lucky bag once.
· Unused Daruma Tokens during the event period can be kept for the next event.
· The Lucky Bag Draw rewards are removed from the reward pool once they have been drawn. The system will randomly draw a not yet obtained prize for the guest, according to the draw rate weight of the prizes left.
· This Lucky Bag contains Kinnara's Alternative Art - New Year Blessing, Avatar - Chocho, Dynamic Avatar Frame - Great Blessing of the Year of the Snake, Card Back - Lanterns Reflecting the Night, and more amazing rewards.
· You can get the rest of the rewards after obtaining the reward of the black Daruma on top.

· Available Time: From after the maintenance on February 13, 2025.
· The construction of the Alternative Art Pre-built Decks will offer decks with mature and stable win rates in Ranked Matches.
· Each Pre-built Deck is priced based on the number of SSR Cards, SR Cards, and the price of Alternative Art Cards in the deck.
· The Alternative Art Pre-built Deck will be available for a limited-time special offer after it is listed. The special offer will end at 24:00 on February 26. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.
· If guests already have the Alternative Art Cards corresponding to the pre-built deck, they will not be able to purchase the pre-built deck corresponding to this Alternative Art.

notes.content:

{Dragon Abyss Data Pack Grand Launch}
The new Dragon Abyss data pack of Onmyoji: The Card Game is now available, featuring 6 new Shikigami.

· Includes six new Shikigami: Karasu Tengu - Akiba, Bukkuman - Zhixing, Magatsugami, Four Dots, Otakemaru: Oath, and Chi Li.

· The Dragon Abyss Card Pack rebate event will be available after the maintenance on January 23, 2025 until 24:00 of February 11, 2025. During the event, when purchasing any 10 card packs with Jade, players will get 1 free Dragon Abyss Card Pack, up to 5 packs.
· The 6 Shikigami of the Dragon Abyss Card Pack are now all available. More Shikigami and more cards will be obtainable from new Card Packs or by other means in the future.

{Dragon Abyss Data Pack Adjustments}
· Added the Master Collector title for the Dragon Abyss data pack. 
· Changed the requirement of the Supreme Collector title to collecting all cards of the 196 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included). 
· Changed the requirement of the Inked Heart title to collecting all Inked cards of the 196 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· Changed the requirement of the Bright Glaze title to collecting all Glass Card Frames of the 196 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).

Before adjustment: Does not stack. Attached Shikigami +1#[力量]. If the Shikigami has three of your Invocations, change to +3#[力量].
After adjustment: Does not stack. Attached Shikigami +1#[力量]. If the Shikigami has three of your Invocations, change to +3#[力量].

Before the Adjustment: When your Shikigami attacks and deals attack damage to an opponent Shikigami, change the opponent Shikigami's Health to 1.	
After the Adjustment: Summon a "Serpent Swarm" when entering the field. When your Shikigami attacks and deals attack damage to an opponent Shikigami, change the opponent Shikigami's Health to 1.

Before adjustment: When entering the battlefield, give a Shikigami Unyielding. Once every turn, when your Shikigami's Health becomes 1 or when a Summon with 1 Health enters the battlefield during your turn, draw a card and give it -2 Intensity.
After adjustment: When entering the battlefield, give a Shikigami Unyielding. Once every turn, when your Shikigami's Health becomes 1 or when a Summon with 1 Health enters the battlefield, draw a card and give it -2 Intensity.

Before adjustment: Evolve: Countdown 2: Gain 1 Power and launch an attack and gain immunity to attack damage during this attack. The reduced countdown effect caused by your cards to your non-defeated Shikigami except for Yamakaze will cause the same effect to Yamakaze. (Take effect when Yamakaze is defeated.)	
After adjustment: Trick: Reduce Yamakaze Countdown by 1, gain 1 Health and 1 Power. Evolve: Countdown 2: Gain 1 Power and launch an attack and gain immunity to attack damage during this attack. The reduced countdown effect caused by your cards to your non-defeated Shikigami except for Yamakaze will cause the same effect to Yamakaze. (Take effect when Yamakaze is defeated.)

Before the Adjustment: Fast, move 1 of your Shikigami and its countdown -1.		
After the Adjustment: Fast, move 1 of your Shikigami and its countdown -1. If it does not have a countdown, draw a card.	

Evolve: Ichimokuren					
Before the Adjustment: Evolve: Trigger countdown when Ichimokuren's Form card is played, removed, or defeated.
After the Adjustment: Randomly gain an Ichimokuren Form card. Evolve: Trigger countdown when Ichimokuren's Form card is played, removed, or defeated.	

Evolve: Wuchen													
Before adjustment: Gain 1 random Wuchen Combat Card. Evolve: Once every turn, when Wuchen moves, his next card played during this turn will not cost any Orbs, and its Charged effect will be triggered even if the card's uncharged.
After adjustment: Choose a Wuchen Combat Card and place it into your hand. Evolve: Once every turn, when Wuchen moves, his next card played during this turn will not cost any Orbs, and its Charged effect will be triggered even if the card's uncharged.

Original Aspiration													
Before the Adjustment: Basic boost +1 Power/+0 Shield
After the Adjustment: Basic boost +2 Power/+0 Shield

Boil sugar with full heat		
Before the Adjustment: Deal 3 damage to a unit. Recover 1 Health for every Ingredient or Delicacy card you have in your hand.				
After adjustment: Deal 3 damage to a unit and recover 2 Health. Recover an additional 1 Health for every Ingredient or Delicacy card you have in your hand.

Before the Adjustment: Draw 2 cards. Enhance: If you gain 3 Delicacy cards in this game, this card gains Fast.			
After the Adjustment: Draw 2 cards and recover 2 Health. Enhance: If you gain 3 Delicacy cards in this game, this card gains Fast and additionally recovers 2 Health.

The Shinki Championship Has Begun!

· The event is divided into three stages: qualifiers, semi-finals, and finals.
Guests can register up to three times per day during the qualifier/semi-final stage. The first registration is free and subsequent registrations will each cost 10,000 Gold. Guests can register twice in total during the finals, both for free.
The deck selected cannot be modified after each registration. The challenge ends after winning 5 games or losing 2 games.
· Opening time:
Qualifiers: Open all day from after the maintenance on December 5, 2024 to 24:00 on December 8, 2024.
Semi-finals: Open all day from December 9, 2024 to 24:00 on December 12, 2024.
Finals: Open all day from December 13, 2024 to 24:00 on December 14, 2024.
· Guests can gain Gold and Random Card Packs based on the number of wins in each challenge. Players who advance to the semi-finals/finals will have a chance to get limited title Ornate Blossom, limited card back Fun Searching, Random Card Packs, Glass Stones and more rewards!

Sweet Wine of Heart - Hiyoribou: Haruki - Collector Edition Alternative Art Now in the Shop

(Guests must first purchase the corresponding Buddies Fight Alternative Art before buying the Buddies Fight Victory Packs.)

Standard Ranked Match Balance Changes

· The following cards have been enhanced:

Bubble Shield
Before the Adjustment: Tactical, Shelter.
After the Adjustment: Tactical, Shelter. When played from hand, draw 1 extra card.

Healing Bubble 
Before the Adjustment: Shelter, and each Sheltered card in your hand will recover 1 Health for you.
After the Adjustment: Shelter, and recover 2 Health for you. For each Sheltered card in your hand, the recovery effect is increased by 1.

Story Ends 
Before the Adjustment: Evolve: When an opponent Shikigami is defeated, gain 2 Life Essence cards. When one of your Shikigami is defeated, deal 1 damage to a random opponent Shikigami and 1 damage to the opponent player.
After the Adjustment: Gain 2 Life Essence. Evolve: When an opponent Shikigami is defeated, gain 2 Life Essence cards. When one of your Shikigami is defeated, deal 1 damage to a random opponent Shikigami and 1 damage to the opponent player.

Tengu's Justice 
Before the Adjustment: When Ootengu: Steel Storm plays a Spell card, gain Barrier. When Ootengu: Steel Storm plays a Combat card, countdown -1.
After the Adjustment: When entering the battlefield, reduce Ootengu: Steel Storm's defeat countdown by 1. When Ootengu: Steel Storm plays a Spell card, gain Barrier. When Ootengu: Steel Storm plays a Combat card, countdown -1.

One Night's Dream 
Before the Adjustment: Tactical. Revive one of your other Shikigami or make one of your other Shikigami attack.
After the Adjustment: Tactical. Revive one of your other Shikigami or give one of your other Shikigami 1 Combat Power and make it attack.

Holy Staff 
Before the Adjustment: Basic boost +0 Power/+0 Shield
After the Adjustment: Basic boost +0 Power/+1 Shield

Thunder Fury 
Before the Adjustment: Draw 1 card when Ryomen deals attack damage to the opponent player. Enhance: Gain Piercing when this card is linked to and played.
After the Adjustment: Draw 1 card when Ryomen deals attack damage to the opponent player. Enhance: Gain Piercing and +1 Power when this card is linked to and played.

Grand Illusion 
Before the Adjustment: Basic Stats: 3/6
After the Adjustment: Basic Stats: 4/6

Freehand 
Before the Adjustment: Stun a random opponent Shikigami, then defeat all stunned Shikigami.
After the Adjustment: Stun a random opponent Shikigami, then defeat all stunned Shikigami. Trick: Stun a random opponent Shikigami.

Aftertaste 
Before the Adjustment: Repeat 3 times and remove the top card of your library. If it is a Combat card, make Gaki attack once; if it is a Form card, recover 4 Health; if it is any Other card, draw 1 card.
After the Adjustment: Repeat 3 times and remove the top card of your library. If it is a Combat card, make Gaki attack once and give it immunity to attack damage; if it is a Form card, recover 5 Health; if it is any Other card, draw 1 card.

Rake in Wealth 
Before the Adjustment: When dealing attack damage to the player, add 1 Lucky Coin to your hand.
After the Adjustment: Piercing. When dealing attack damage to the player, add 1 Lucky Coin to your hand.

Scam 
Before the Adjustment: Enhance: This card gains Fatal if Lucky Coin has been played during this turn.
After the Adjustment: Enhance: This card gains Fatal if Lucky Coin has been used during this turn. Enhance: Gain Unyielding during this combat if you've played 3 Lucky Coin during this game.

Evolve: Hitotsume 
Before the Adjustment: Evolve: Whenever Hitotsume takes attack damage from an opponent Shikigami, Projectile: Deal 3 damage.
After the Adjustment: Move Hitotsume to the Combat Zone. Evolve: Whenever Hitotsume takes attack damage from an opponent Shikigami, Projectile: Deal 3 damage.

Homing Bird 
Before the Adjustment: Remove your Painting Realm and deal 1+ Intensity damage to a Shikigami. If the opponent is defeated, draw 1 card.
After the Adjustment: Remove your Painting Realm and deal 1+ Intensity damage to a Shikigami. If the Shikigami is defeated, draw 1 card and summon 1 Painting Realm at the start of the opponent's turn.

Ferocity 
Before the Adjustment: Stun an opponent Shikigami. If this Shikigami has ≥5 Power, defeat this Shikigami.
After the Adjustment: Stun an opponent Shikigami. If this Shikigami has ≥5 Power, defeat this Shikigami. Otherwise, draw 1 card.

Before the Adjustment: Whenever your Shikigami take damage, the Shikigami gains 1 Shield.
After the Adjustment: When entering the battlefield, all of your Shikigami gain 1 Shield. Whenever a Shikigami of yours takes damage, the Shikigami gains 1 Shield.

The following cards have been adjusted and nerfed

Revolving Genies 
Before the Adjustment: Fast. Attach Sea Genie to one of your Shikigami. Divination 2.
After the Adjustment: Fast. Attach Sea Genie to one of your Shikigami. Draw 1 card.

Before the Adjustment: When entering the battlefield, attach Ghostgator to one of your Shikigami. Give your Shikigami Haste when it attaches Ghostgator.
After the Adjustment: When entering the battlefield, attach Ghostgator to one of your Shikigami. When Ghostgator is attached to a Shikigami of yours, give the Shikigami Haste and reduce Intensity by 2

After the Adjustment: Deal damage equal to your Nightfall points to a Shikigami. Nightfall 5: Deal 3 damage to the opponent player.

Phantasmal Dreams Adjustments
To focus our energy on developing new gameplay features, we are making the following adjustments:

Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on November 7, 2024.

SE29 Approaches
SE29 is about to start!
· Season 40 of Onmyoji: The Card Game will start at 00:00 on November 16, 2024. Season Special Basic Alternative Art - Youning: Delicate Grace, Avatar - Momo: Hafubuki, Permanent Battlefield Special Effects - Broadcast: Sand of Time, Seal: Onsen, Transition Wallpaper: Feng, Ya, Song, Derived Sparkling Cards, Match Emojis, Glass Card Frame: Basic x3, and other great rewards await you!
· There is a higher chance of getting cards that you don't have yet when getting the SSR cards in the Tour Pass Rewards. If you've got all of them, then you'll have a higher chance of getting cards that you have fewer than 2 copies of.

Sealed Deck - Misty Mirage Special Event Back Again
Event Time: From after the maintenance on November 7 to 10:00 on November 21.
In this event, the gameplay of the sealed deck will undergo significant changes:
1. The initial deck building is divided into two rounds. In the first round, you will choose 4 initial Shikigami and receive 5 random cards for each chosen Shikigami. In the second round, two sets of cards for each Shikigami will be displayed, each set containing 3 cards. You will choose one set to complete the Shikigami's 8 cards.
2. After completing the deck-building phase, you will enter a randomly generated map. By spending Orbs to explore the map, you can obtain new Shikigami, new cards, and unique collectibles to enhance your abilities. Additionally, you can upgrade cards into their powerful counterparts that are only effective in Sealed Deck.
3. Once Orbs are depleted, you can engage in match combat with other players and end the current turn. A single Sealed Deck game can last up to 8 turns each time.
Sealed Deck Objectives：
1. When you enter the game, you start with 8 Victory Stars. You can earn more by winning combat or exploring the map. Once you gather 25 or more Stars, you achieve victory.
2. Collect 3 Map Shards (after collecting them, manually tap the Map Shard button on the left of the map to win).
3. You start with 3 Health in the game. Each time you lose a match, you lose 1 Health. When Health drops to zero, the game ends (Health can be restored through map events).
4. If the number of Victory Stars is less than the required ante for the next turn, the game ends.
Betting and Raising in Combat:
1. Both players must wager Victory Stars equal to the ante during combat, which increases with each turn.
2. During combat, both players can raise the bet during their first turn. Each player has only one chance to do so per battle.
3. When combat ends, the winner gains the wagered Victory Stars, while the loser loses them.
New Mechanisms and Improvements
New Map Event: Purchase Neutral Card
Neutral cards with unique abilities can now be purchased with Bliss Coins in Sealed Deck. (45 cards in total)
All neutral cards have a new mechanism, Winning Hand: When you draw a card with Winning Hand for the first time each turn, you may draw an additional card.
New Starting Event:
After selecting a map, you can choose one of the 4 fixed options to trigger an event.
Pre-built Deck
After entering the map, tiles for pre-built decks will be generated. You can head to those tiles and choose pre-built decks of fixed Shikigami.
· Added new collectibles and new chance events.
· Adjusted some map event values.
· Updated victory rewards. Victory rewards are now divided into 3 parts.
1. With 30 Stars as a cycle, guests can get Card Packs of the latest four versions, Jikikaeru Tickets, and random SR cards in order.
2. As long as you win, you will be rewarded with fixed random SR cards and Glass Stones.
3. You can get rewards for every 30 stars you accumulate. There are a total of 10 reward tiers, which include random SSR cards, PYO Card Packs, Emoji, and Transition Wallpaper - Prologue Moonless Night, ready for you to claim.

When Spell of Forgetfulness enters the battlefield, shuffle a random exclusive card of it back into the library. When leaving the battlefield, you draw a card.

At the start of your turn, if you don't have any Summons in your Combat Zone, summon a Serpent Swarm.#rAll your Shikigami with 1#[Health] become immune to non-attack damage and gain Piercing and immunity to attack damage when attacking.

Classic of Poetry

Once every turn for each effect, when your Shikigami plays a card from your hand that does not share the same name with a card in the initial library, if the card is a non-Evolve Spell card obtained through Youning's effect, copy that Spell and play it again. Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on September 5, 2024.

Sealed Deck - Misty Mirage Special Event
In this event, the gameplay of the sealed deck will undergo significant changes:
1. The initial deck building is divided into two rounds. In the first round, you will choose 4 initial Shikigami and receive 5 random cards for each chosen Shikigami. In the second round, two sets of cards for each Shikigami will be displayed, each set containing 3 cards. You will choose one set to complete the Shikigami's 8 cards.
2. After completing the deck-building phase, you will enter a randomly generated map. By spending Orbs to explore the map, you can obtain new Shikigami, new cards, and unique collectibles to enhance your abilities. Additionally, you can upgrade cards into their powerful counterparts that are only effective in Sealed Deck.
3. Once Orbs are depleted, you can engage in match combat with other players and end the current turn. A single Sealed Deck game can last up to 8 turns each time.
Sealed Deck Objectives：
1. When you enter the game, you start with 8 Victory Stars. You can earn more by winning combat or exploring the map. Once you gather 25 or more Stars, you achieve victory.
2. Collect 3 Map Shards (after collecting them, manually tap the Map Shard button on the left of the map to win).
3. You start with 3 Health in the game. Each time you lose a match, you lose 1 Health. When Health drops to zero, the game ends (Health can be restored through map events).
4. If the number of Victory Stars is less than the required ante for the next turn, the game ends.
Betting and Raising in Combat:
1. Both players must wager Victory Stars equal to the ante during combat, which increases with each turn.
2. During combat, both players can raise the bet during their first turn. Each player has only one chance to do so per battle.
3. When combat ends, the winner gains the wagered Victory Stars, while the loser loses them.
Sealed Deck Settlement Rewards:
1. Players who win in the game can accumulate their Victory Stars for the season and receive rewards based on the number of Stars collected.
2. Players who do not win in the game will not accumulate Victory Stars. But don't be discouraged, rewards will be given based on the number of wins achieved in the current game.

Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on August 8, 2024.

SE27 Approaches
SE27 is about to start!
· Season 27 of Onmyoji: The Card Game will start at 00:00 on August 16, 2024. Season Special Form Alternative Art - Izanami: Divine's Kiss, Avatar - Yamakaze, Permanent Battlefield Special Effects - Rebirth: Yoshiba, Card Back - Treasures of the Sea, Transition Wallpaper: Share Life and Death, Derived Sparkling Cards, Match Emojis, Glass Card Frame: Basic x3, and other great rewards await you!
· There is a higher chance of getting cards that you don't have yet when getting the SSR cards in the Tour Pass Rewards. If you've got all of them, then you'll have a higher chance of getting cards that you have fewer than 2 copies of.

Shinkiro Summer Festival I
· Shinkiro Summer Festival is here! Mitsume wants to invite some Shikigami to join a lively beach party!
· However, everyone seems to be busy dealing with their own troubles, making it difficult for them to join the party. So Mitsume plans to help them out first and then invite them to the beach for a lively Shinkiro Summer Festival!
Invite Shikigami
During the event, each guest has 3 opportunities per day to invite one Shikigami from a selection of 9 Shikigami.
· Each Shikigami needs to complete 3 invitation quests before all cards can be unlocked and the Shikigami can be invited to the party.
· The invitation quests require completing combat. Each Shikigami will have 4 quests that players need to complete.
· The cards of the 4 Cat Waiters will be unlocked right away, and you can use them to complete quests.
· As more Shikigami are invited, you can use the cards of these invited Shikigami to create more creative decks.
Endless Mode
· After inviting at least one Shikigami to the festival, Endless Mode will be unlocked.
· In Endless Mode, you will face endless quests.
· After each round of quests is completed, new and increasingly challenging quests will appear.
· Guests have 3 turns to complete each round of quests. After 3 turns, the current Endless Mode challenge ends.
· Endless Mode challenges can be challenged freely. Each challenge will record your points (challenge level x 100 - the number of turns), which will be used for Rankings challenges.
Create Special Shinkiro Summer Festival Memories
· As more Shikigami are invited, you can also unlock Twin Annihilation Card Packs as rewards. After completing the final invitation, you will receive a unique Transition Wallpaper as a reward.
Shinkiro Summer Festival Tour Pass
· You can upgrade your Shinkiro Summer Festival Tour Pass by completing Tour Pass quests to earn points. The Shinkiro Summer Festival Tour Pass has a total of 20 levels. As you progress through the levels, you can unlock rewards such as Blossoms, Toughness Stones, Ink Jade, Glass Stones, Twin Annihilation Card Packs, and more.
· Additionally, you can spend Jade to unlock the Golden Route. By doing so, you'll obtain the Doodle Basic Alternative Art for 3 Shikigami: Susabi: Origin - Wave of Defiance, Joruri Gozen - Tide of Dark Raven, and Kaguya - Summer Chill. You'll also earn amazing rewards such as Blossoms, Toughness Stones, Ink Jade, Glass Stones, Twin Annihilation Card Packs, and more.
· More Shikigami who have not yet been invited will gradually be introduced in subsequent events of the Shinkiro Summer Festival, so stay tuned. Additionally, more Doodle Alternative Art for various Shikigami will be released in the future.

PYO SSR Card Pack Now Available
· PYO SSR Card Pack will be available in the Jade Shop from 10:00 on August 8, 2024 to 24:00 on August 21, 2024. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.
· The pack contains 1 PYO SSR card! Select any Shikigami and gain 1 SSR card of that Shikigami.
· Including: Classic, Nightless Fire, Moonlit Fantasy, Slice Up The Sea, Fortune and Enmusubi, Four Guardians, Good or Evil, Flowers in Slumber, Fleeting Dreams, Noisy Cooking Battle, Paradise Chords, Interwoven Fates, Ethereal Essence, Thundering Awakening, Lantern Tales, Mortal Reincarnation, Home of Peach Blossom, Stellar Enlightenment, and Twin Annihilation series (excludes Kyonshi Imoto).

Expert Pre-built Deck: Mask of Black and White Soon Available in Jade Shop

· Expert Pre-built Deck: Mask of Black and White contains 2 SSR Cards: Reflection of Heart and Delion's Promise, and 6 SR Cards. If you need to strengthen your deck, head to the Jade Shop to get yours!

Voyage Pass: S4 Now Available
· Guests can spend 248 Jade to purchase the Voyage Pass: S4. Once purchased, Voyage Pass: S4 will be instantly leveled up to Lv. 9, allowing guests to immediately earn all exclusive Doodle Alternative Art of the current Voyage Pass. This includes Doodle Alternative Art for Maestro's Basic Shikigami and its 8 cards, along with the corresponding 9 Inked Card Frames.
· The Voyage Pass has a total of 30 levels. Guests can earn points by completing the specified point quests to level up the Voyage Pass. Claim corresponding rewards once the Voyage Pass reaches a certain level. Each reward can only be claimed once.
· Guests can directly purchase levels for the Voyage Pass at a cost of 3 Jade per level. Please spend money responsibly.

· Next Rotating Item - Basic Card Dyed Alternative Art: Kidomaru
· Rotating Items: These items automatically rotate every 30 days, refreshing at 00:00 each day. You can't manually refresh them with a Purchase Request.

Alternative Art Takes Turns to Discount: Twenty-First Turn Begins
· Many Alternative Arts which have been sold for over one year will enjoy a discount for a limited time during each turn, guests can head to the Alternative Art Shop to purchase them! 
· Event Time: From 10:00 on August 15, 2024 to 9:00 on October 3, 2024. 
· Discounted Alternative Art during this turn: Tamamonomae: Nine-tail Inferno, Shiranui: Passing Beauty, Kosodenote: Inseparable Threads, Genkuro: Glorious Sunset, Senhime: Faraway Song, Bukkuman: Summer Travels.

Standard Ranked Match Balance Adjustments
· The following cards have been adjusted:

24 Floral Breezes
Changed the effect to: Origin: Floral Breeze. Fast, add a 24 Floral Breezes from the library to your hand. Give one of your Shikigami +1 Combat Power.

Evolve: Izanami
Changed the effect to: Summon a Serpent Swarm. Evolve: During your turn, if a Shikigami's Health becomes 1 or a Summon with 1 Health enters the battlefield or a Shikigami with 1 Health attacks, deal 1 damage to a random opponent unit.

Windmill: Thunderfire Shell
Changed the basic boost to +0 Power/+0 Shield.

Leap
Changed the basic boost to +0 Power/+0 Shield.

Original Aspiration
Changed the basic boost to +1 Power/+0 Shield.

· The following cards have been enhanced:

Tasting Conference
Changed the effect to: Haste. When Usagi is attacking a Shikigami or attacked by a Shikigami, Luck 4: Give an Unidentified Ingredient to this Shikigami.

Evolve: Tamamonomae
Changed the effect to: Select a Level 1 Spell card of Tamamonomae and add it to your hand. Evolve: When Tamamonomae plays a card other than the ones in its hand, Projectile: Deal 3 damage. At the end of your turn, play a random Level 1 Spell card.

Symbiosis
Changed the effect to: When entering the battlefield and when Futakuchi attacks, spend 2 Energy and randomly make the Focus effect of an exclusive card with a level not higher than Futakuchi's current level take effect. Focus: Activate an additional time at random.

Evolve: Futakuchi
Changed the effect to: Fast#rFocus: Gain 3 Energy and Projectile: Deal 2 damage. Evolve: Charge. At the start of your turn, Futakuchi additionally gains 1 Energy. When your Shikigami plays a card with Focus, spend 2 Energy of Futakuchi instead of the extra Orbs cost by Focus.

Blackout
Changed the basic stats to 4 Power/8 Health.

Evolve: Nekomata
Changed the effect to: Add 1 random Ingredient to your hand. Evolve: At the start of your turn, add 1 random Ingredient to your hand. When your Summon enters the battlefield, play up to 2 random Ingredient cards from your hand on it.

Changed the effect to: Fortitude. Charged: Hunt.

Eternal Fire
Changed the effect to: Sacred Scorching Fire gains 3 Power and immunity to attack damage during your turn. When entering the battlefield or at the start of your turn, make Suzuhiko Hime or Sacred Scorching Fire launch an attack and restore all its Health.

Evolve: Kawazaru
Changed the effect to: Playable when defeated. Revive Kawazaru. Evolve: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Master Shapeshifter that does not cost any Orbs and can be played on the opponent Shikigami.

Moon Grasping
Changed the effect to: When entering the battlefield and at the start of each turn, Kawazaru's Power and Health become the highest Power and Health of your other Shikigami on the battlefield respectively. If Kawazaru already has the highest Power and Health, it instead gains +2 Power/+2 Health.

Child of Darkness
Changed the effect to: Whenever Asura attacks, it deals 1 damage to you.

Arachnid Horde
Changed the effect to: When entering the battlefield, deal damage equal to Jorogumo's level to all opponent Shikigami. When an opponent Shikigami is defeated, gain 1 Intensity, deal 1 damage to the opponent player, and recover 1 Health for your player.

Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on August 14, 2024. (Up to twice for each type)

Improvements and Bug Fixes
· Fixed the incorrect name of Izanami in Shikigami.
· Fixed an issue where Evolve: Tomato, when boosted by Piercing and Attack!, could leave the opponent player with 0 Health but still alive after assaulting.
· Fixed the issue where, when Nusubitogami's Treasure allowed the next Level 1 non-neutral card to not cost any Orbs, using a non-Level 1 Origin card with a Level 1 main card would also not cost any Orbs, and Treasure's boost count would not be reduced.
· Fixed an issue where in the Enlightenment state, Susabi: Origin could not properly enter Enlightenment after playing a Combat card if its basic ability had not been triggered before.

Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on July 25, 2024.

The Twin Annihilation Data Pack Now Available
The new Twin Annihilation data pack of Onmyoji: The Card Game is now available, featuring 8 new Shikigami.
· Twin Annihilation Card Packs will be available after the maintenance on July 25, 2024. 
· Including 8 new original Shikigami: Izanami, Menreiki: Heart, Kusa: Dandelion, Kuro Mujou, Shiro Mujou, Nusubitogami, Kamimai, and Oguna/Doujo.
· After the new Twin Annihilation data pack becomes available on July 25, guests will be able to claim 3 free Twin Annihilation Card Packs by logging into the game. 
· The Twin Annihilation Card Pack rebate event will be available after the maintenance on July 25, 2024 until 24:00 of August 13, 2024. During the event, when purchasing any 10 card packs with Jade, guests will get 1 free Twin Annihilation Card Pack, up to 5 packs.
· The 8 Shikigami of the Twin Annihilation Card Pack are now all available. More Shikigami will be obtainable from new Card Packs or by other means in the future.
· Added bios of Reinforce Shikigami Kuro Mujou/Shiro Mujou. Twin Annihilation's new Shikigami Kuro Mujou and Shiro Mujou will show their respective bios.

Guest Room
· Guests now have their own Guest Rooms! You can enter it via Guest Room on the lobby screen.
· In the Guest Room, you can effortlessly access various gameplay features of Onmyoji: The Card Game, making it easier to navigate.
· Additionally, you can customize your Guest Room by changing the displayed Shikigami, decorating it with your collected backgrounds, and changing the background music.
· To return to the original lobby, you can find the Exit in the upper right corner of the Guest Room.
· The features of Guest Room are still being improved, so please stay tuned for future updates.

Twin Annihilation Data Pack Adjustments
· Added the Master Collector title for the Twin Annihilation data pack. 
· Changed the requirement of the Supreme Collector title to collecting all cards of the 182 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included). 
· Changed the requirement of the Inked Heart title to collecting all Inked cards of the 182 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· Changed the requirement of the Bright Glaze title to collecting all Glass Card Frames of the 182 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· The Twin Annihilation Card Packs can now be purchased in the Hyakubun Scrollery.
· Added 8 new Shikigami of the Twin Annihilation data pack to Sealed Deck. 
· The card pack rewards from Sealed Deck will include Stellar Enlightenment Card Packs. The random card rewards will include cards of the 8 new Shikigami from the Twin Annihilation data pack. 
· The rewards of Kaidan Chapter 1, 2 & 3 will include cards of the 8 new Shikigami from the Twin Annihilation data pack.

The Twin Annihilation Packs are Now Available
· The Twin Annihilation Special Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on July 25, 2024, containing 30 Twin Annihilation Card Packs.
· The Twin Annihilation Welcome Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on July 25, 2024, containing 10 Twin Annihilation Card Packs.

Standard Mode Balance Adjustments

Changed the basic stats to 5 Power/7 Health.
Changed the effect to: Origin: Stellar Field. When you play a card from the Enlightenment Zone, gain 1 Combat Power and 1 Shield.

Roar
Changed the effect to: Yamawaro gains 1 Power permanently. Your other Shikigami gain 1 Power.

Wish
Changed the effect to: Your Kuro and Shiro gain 2 Power and 2 Health.

Phantasmal Dreams Balance Adjustments

The following cards have been adjusted and nerfed:
Roar
Changed the effect to: Give all your Shikigami 1 Attack.

Evolve: Susabi
Changed the effect to:
Evolve: Whenever Susabi deals attack damage, all your Fields gain 1 Intensity. When you play a Field Card, Susabi gains Haste.

Evolve: Suzuka Gozen
Changed the effect to:
Projectile: Deal 1 damage. Evolve: When Suzuka Gozen deals damage to a unit, inflict Fragile to the same amount (3 at most).

Realm of Glass

Adjudicator

The following cards have been enhanced:

Flicker
Changed the effect to: Power of the Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone becomes 0 during this turn. Enhance: At the start of your turn, if Kusa has a Form, this card gains Fast during this turn. Trigger: Play automatically when an opponent Shikigami enters the Combat Zone.

Hunting Prayer

· Fixed the issue where some abilities of Evolve: Nihitomi would trigger twice at the start of each turn.
· Fixed the issue in Phantasmal Dreams where the Double: Furi summoned by Evolve: Furi had incorrect stats.
· Fixed the issue in Phantasmal Dreams where Ghost might have incorrect stats after Fusion.
· Fixed the issue in Phantasmal Dreams where Enma wouldn't gain Power after Ghost is defeated when the King of Underworld Form is on the battlefield.
· You can now complete the daily First Victory in Ranked Match quest and Tour Pass's Ranked Match point quests in the Phantasmal Dreams.
· Fixed the issue where the bonus stats given by Genkuro's Hatsune no Tsuzumi to your Shikigami were displayed incorrectly in the Shikigami details.
· Fixed the issue where Aoandon: Wildfire's Form Brilliant Light didn't have a dynamic card cover in matches.
· Fixed the issue where spectators couldn't see the card swap animation.
· Fixed the issue where Aoandon: Wildfire Brilliant Light's card drawing effect wouldn't be triggered when Momo: Hafubuki plays the Origin card Momo Breeze.
· Fixed the issue in Hyakubun Chess where Miketsu's abilities were not working.
· Fixed the issue where Blazing Flame would not lose its Combat Power after attacking.
· Fixed the issue where Aoandon: Wildfire could use both remaining effects of Book of Tales at the start of the opponent's turn after using it.
· Fixed the issue where the derivative options of your Burst cards would repeatedly appear in the selection screen when Evolve: Hiyoribou was on the battlefield.

· Guests can sign up for the Early-summer Championship, pick their best deck, and compete with other guests for the championship.

· Opening time:
Qualifiers: Open all day from after the maintenance on June 20, 2024 to 24:00 on June 23, 2024.
Semi-finals: Open all day from June 24, 2024 to 24:00 on June 27, 2024.
Finals: Open all day from June 28, 2024 to 24:00 on June 29, 2024.
· Guests can gain Gold and Random Card Packs based on the number of wins in each challenge. Players who advance to the semi-finals/finals will have a chance to get limited title Wavecrest Summer, limited card back Swim in the Pool, Random Card Packs, Glass Stones and more rewards!

Time flies, Onmyoji: The Card Game has been around for 4 years now! To thank you all for your continued support, we have prepared many amazing events and benefits for everyone!

Four years together, a thousand journeys united!
· Event Time: From after the maintenance on June 12, 2024 to 24:00 on June 27, 2024.
Event Description:
· During the event, guests can log in daily to receive a total of 3 Stellar Enlightenment Card Packs and other generous rewards. Log in for four days to obtain the Limited Title: Lucky to Have You and Limited Card Back: Flowing Light - Shinkiro Sightseeing. Log in for seven days to obtain the Limited Aoandon: Wildfire Alternative Art: Tales All Around.

· This time's Wine-tasting Showdown will include new player skills, special guest skills, and resident guest skills!

· Event Time: From after the maintenance on June 6, 2024 to 24:00 on June 15, 2024.
· During the event, each guest gets 3 chances to craft cards at half-price.

When you play a card attached to Heaven's Light, draw 1 card, add it to the Enlightenment Zone, and attach it to Heaven's Light. Then enter Enlightenment.

· Fixed an issue where cards with Hunt effects couldn't perform follow-up actions after Matsu linking to and using Enhance from the library.
· Fixed an issue where, when Matsu's Form Emerging Dreams is on the battlefield and you don't have any Orbs, Emerging Dreams couldn't be activated properly when linking to and using multi-choice cards.
· Fixed an issue where Matsu could select cards of your stunned Shikigami after linking to them.
· Fixed an issue where the Intensity of a Field with changed Intensity was incorrectly displayed in the Enlightenment Zone after it was added to the Enlightenment Zone from the battlefield.
· Fixed an issue where the summoned cards obtained from Inked cards such as Evolve: Onikiri and Movement did not obtain their Inked Card Frames.

Dye your art with wondrous colors!

Wonder Dye Entrance
After purchasing the Wonder Dye Alternative Art, guests can access the Wonder Dye screen via Shikigami → Alternative Art → the Dye button at the bottom-left corner.

Wonder Dye Process
Choose dyeing area → Dye that area → Save the dye scheme.
Select the desired area for dyeing by tapping the area panel on the left.
Dye the selected area using the Color Palette on the right.

Color Palette
· The color palette offers two coloring modes: Light Color and Bold Color. It provides two adjustment methods: HSL and RGB. Guests can freely adjust three color parameters: hue, saturation, and brightness, in any combination they prefer.
No need to worry about making mistakes. We've got you covered with Reset, Undo, Redo, and Reset All buttons, letting you backtrack and save up to hundreds of steps in real time.

Wonder Dye Slot
· Each saved scheme will be stored in the corresponding dye slot.
· There are a total of 3 tabs of dye slots, with 5 slots per tab. The slots on the first tab are available for free, while those on other tabs require Daruma Coins to unlock.

· Export: Select the Wonder Dye scheme you want to share, tap Export, and you can share the Wonder Dye code instantly on the World Channel, Friend Channel, or manually paste it on social media platforms.

Ranked Matchmaking Algorithm Improvements
· Optimized the matchmaking algorithm in ranked matches, reducing the priority of matching guests across different tiers.
· Specifically, in the first 5 seconds of ranked matchmaking, the algorithm will prioritize matching guests that are one tier above or below you. Every 5 seconds thereafter, the range expands by an additional tier above and below. When there's a difference of more than one tier, an extra 20 seconds are required to match across tiers.
· In future updates, we will continue to further optimize the ranked matchmaking algorithm to improve the matchmaking experience for all guests.

Improvements and Bug Fixes
· Optimized the animation speed for creating cards into the Enlightenment Zone.
· Fixed an issue where the oppotent's Form cards previously revealed by Tsukuyomi: Lie would appear face-down in the selection screen.
· Fixed the incorrect Health value of the Double: Furi summoned by Furi's Kuji-kiri.
· Fixed an issue where Kosodenote's Fix-up would also take effect when using non-Shikigami exclusive Spell cards.

notes.title: Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425662/a8fd33c2542f2fa3b8c2d837c1e2b2cd576f3458.png[/img]
Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on March 7, 2024.

Reinforce Shikigami Yamausagi/Zashiki Arrives!
· The Reinforce Shikigami Yamausagi/Zashiki has been added to the Home of Peach Blossom Card Pack pool with Fortune Dice.
· The 9 Shikigami of the Home of Peach Blossom Card Pack are now all available. More Shikigami will be obtainable from new Card Packs or by other means in the future.
· After adding Yamausagi/Zashiki to the deck, you won't be able to add Yamausagi or Zashiki separately in the deck.

New Card Appearance - Sparkling Card Cover
· Sparkling Card Covers will add special effects to their corresponding cards during combat.
· When using a specified Card Pack to draw cards, there is a chance to obtain a Sparkling Card Cover. Repeatedly obtaining a Sparkling Card Cover will grant Sparkling Shards.
· Use Sparkling Shards to gild existing card covers. After gilding, all cards with the same name will have Sparkling Card Covers.
· You can remove or reapply gilding in the Shikigami's card details after obtaining a Sparkling Card Cover. Doing this does not cost Sparkling Shards.
· When gilding existing card covers, if you don't have enough Sparkling Shards, you can exchange them using Talismans at a ratio of 4 Talismans for 1 Sparkling Shard.
· Sparkling Card Covers that will be released this time include covers for Spell cards, Combat cards, and Field cards from the Home of Peach Blossom.
· The Sparkling Card Covers for Yamausagi/Zashiki's exclusive cards have not been implemented yet. If you obtain Sparkling Card Covers for Yamausagi/Zashiki, you will be fully compensated with Sparkling Shards.
· Sparkling Card Covers are not compatible with Form cards. If you obtain a Form card with a Sparkling Card Cover, you will be fully compensated with Sparkling Shards.
· Sparkling Card Covers for Yamausagi/Zashiki and cards from other series will be added in future updates.
· You can check the tutorial in the Hyakubun Scrollery for more detailed rules on obtaining a Sparkling Card Cover.

Lucky Month Championship Has Begun!
Yamausagi and Zashiki have prepared for a refreshing new match event.
· Event Time: From after the maintenance on March 7 to 24:00 on March 16.
· Event Description:
· Guests can sign up for the Golden Autumn Championship, pick their best deck, and compete with other guests for the championship. During the event, guests can build decks that can only be used during the event with all cards from all seasons (excludes Kyonshi Imoto) for free and use these decks to play against others.
· The event is divided into qualifiers, semi-finals and finals. Guests can register up to three times per day during the qualifier/semi-final/final stage. The first registration is free and subsequent registrations will each cost 10,000 Gold.
· During this event, guests only need to select 4 Shikigami to build a deck. The system will deploy 32 neutral cards to fill your Library. The deck selected cannot be modified after each registration. The challenge ends after winning 5 games or losing 2 games.
· Opening time: 
Qualifiers: Open all day from after the maintenance on March 7, 2024 to 24:00 on March 10, 2024. 
Semi-finals: Open all day from March 11, 2024 to 24:00 on March 14, 2024.
Finals: Open all day from March 15, 2024 to 24:00 on March 16, 2024. 
· Guests can gain Gold and Random Card Packs based on the number of wins in each challenge. Guests who advance to the semi-finals/finals will have a chance to get limited title Dragon Soars Lion Dances: SSR, Random Card Packs, Glass Card Frame: Basic, Ink Jades, Glass Stones and more rewards!

Auspicious Dragon - Ichimokuren: Sounds of Nature Alternative Art Now Available
· Basic card Alternative Art - Ichimokuren: Sounds of Nature: Auspicious Dragon will be available in the Alternative Art Shop after the maintenance on March 7, 2024. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time. The limited-time discount will end on 24:00 March 20, 2024.

Shiki: Poem of the Seasons Avatar Pack Now Available
· The Shiki: Poem of the Seasons Avatar Pack will be available in the Jade Shop after the maintenance on March 7, 2024. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time and end at 24:00 on March 20.

Dragon's Treasure Combat Background Now Available
· Strike the golden drum to welcome the dragon, bringing fortune and treasures.
· Combat Background - Dragon's Treasure will be available at 10:00 on March 7, 2024. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time. The limited-time discount will end at 24:00 on March 20. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.

Dragon's Blessing Avatar Frame Pack Now Available
· Limited animated avatar frame Dragon's Blessing will be available at 10:00 on March 7, 2024. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time. The limited-time discount will end at 24:00 on March 20. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.

Home of Peach Blossom Pack Now Available
· The Home of Peach Blossom Special Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on March 7, 2024, containing 24 Home of Peach Blossom Card Packs and 6 Yamausagi/Zashiki Card Packs.
· The Home of Peach Blossom Welcome Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on March 7, 2024, containing 8 Home of Peach Blossom Card Packs and 2 Yamausagi/Zashiki Card Packs.

Heartful Gift System Available
1. How to Obtain Heartful Gifts: Guests can purchase Alternative Art at the Red Packet Gift screen in the Alternative Art Shop. Once purchased, the Alternative Art will be stored in your items as Red Packets and will not expire.
2. How to Gift Heartful Gifts: Guests can send Heartful Gifts to their friends through Friend Techou. After tapping Send, the gifted Red Packet will be removed from your items and sent to the recipient’s mailbox.
3. Customized Blessings: When sending a Heartful Gift, guests can a short blessing message.
4. How to Claim Heartful Gifts: When receiving a Heartful Gift from a friend, guests can claim it from their mailbox (the mail is valid for 999 days).
5. Note: Before sending a Heartful Gift, please make sure your friend does not already own the Alternative Art that you are about to gift. If the friend already owns the Alternative Art, it will automatically be converted into a small amount of Alternative Art Shards (This is intended to prevent exploitation, so the number of Alternative Art Shards received from the conversion is quite minimal).

Rotating Shikigami Trial 
· During each turn of the Rotating Shikigami Trial event, guests can try all cards of 12 specific Shikigami for free. 
· Available time of this rotation: From 24:00 on March 14, 2024 to 24:00 on March 31, 2024. 
· Available Shikigami of this rotation: Genkuro, Enmusubi, Kidomaru, Hiyoribou, Shishio, Enenra, Kyonshi Ototo, Kyonshi Ani, Okikumushi, Kainin, Ryomen, Ungaikyo. 

Balance Adjustments
· The following cards have been adjusted:

Misty Wind
Changed the effect to: Origin: Arcane Winds. Stun an opponent Shikigami and deal 3 damage.

Snowman
Changed the basic stats to 1 Power/1 Health.

Boundless
Changed the effect to: When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, recover 2 Health for all your Shikigami. Each Shikigami receiving excess healing from this gains 1 Combat Power and 1 Shield.

Other Improvements and Bug Fixes
· Shikigami now features a Claim All button, allowing you to claim all available rewards with a single tap.
· Fixed the issue where if Fukengaku's Mountain Hiking was defeated due to damage, the healing ability might not trigger until the next time the player takes damage.
· Fixed the incorrect keyword of Emyoudou: Buddha's Wisdom.
· Fixed the issue where Yoto Hime: Cursed Blade's Evolve effect wouldn't activate correctly when playing an Evolve card triggered the opponent Kotodama's Verbal Sin effect and defeated its damage.
· Fixed the issue with the damage distribution logic when Evolve: Langya assaults.

Strategic Move

Balance Adjustments
· The following cards have been adjusted:

Evolve: Langya
Changed the effect to: Evolve: Once every turn, when Langya assaults or plays a card, summon a Spell of Sleep for the opponent, and deal damage equal to the sum of opponent Sigil cards on the battlefield randomly split among opponent Shikigami. For every 2 Intensity the Spell of Sleep has, this damage +1.

Flower Moonnight
Changed the effect to: When entering the battlefield, give 1 of your Shikigami +1 Combat Power. At the start of the opponent's turn, Shikigami in your Combat Zone gain +1 Combat Power.

Breeze of Revival Blossom
Changed the basic stats to 3 Power/5 Health.

Overshadow
Changed the basic boost to +1 Power/+0 Shield.

Homing Bird
Changed the effect to: Remove your Painting Realm and deal damage equal to Intensity +1 to a Shikigami. If the Shikigami is defeated, draw a card.

· The following cards have been enhanced

Girl in the Painting
Changed the effect to: At the end of your turn, if you don't have a Painting Realm, summon 2 Painting Realms with 2 Intensity.

Evolve: Susabi
Changed the effect to: Add a Vast Sea to your hand. Evolve: Whenever Susabi deals attack damage, all your Fields gain 1 Intensity. Whenever you play a Field card, Susabi gains Haste.

Revenge
Changed the effect to: If Kyuumei Neko is defeated after this combat, revive her and make her attack. She is immune to attack damage during this attack. Trigger: This card is played automatically when Kyuumei Neko is attacked.

Purity
Changed the basic stats to 3 Power/5 Health.

Windmill: Thunderfire Shell
Changed the basic boost to +1 Power/+0 Shield.

Evil-Dispelling Arrow
Changed the basic boost to +2 Power/+1 Shield.

Mold Research
Changed the basic stats to 4 Power/7 Health.

Bamboo Thicket
Changed Intensity to 5.

Treasure Box
Changed the effect to: When entering the battlefield and at the start of your turn, Luck 4: recover 2 Health for you. At the end of your turn, use 10 Energy to draw a card.

Dreams
Changed the effect to: Revive all your Shikigami, and give Hako Shoujo 10 Energy. Burst 10: Recover an additional 10 Health for you.

Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on February 12, 2024. (Up to twice for each type)

Improvements and Bug Fixes
· Fixed the issue where Langya's basic abilities would be triggered at the wrong time:
1. Langya will now summon a Spell of Sleep for the opponent player after the assault has been completed and the damage has been calculated instead of when assaulting.
2. Langya will now summon a Spell of Sleep for the opponent player after using a card and the card's effect has been calculated instead of when using the card.
· Fixed the issue where Evolve: Langya's Basic ability would deal 2 damage instead of an additional 1 damage while Evolve: Kosodenote is on the battlefield.
· Fixed the issue where the effect of "non-attack damage dealt +1" granted by the leaving of Season: Spring would not be cleared after Evolve: Shiki is defeated.
· Fixed the issue where guests could select Shikigami in Specter Form to Stand Fast.
————————
*The next maintenance day is February 22.

· Ink Jade Special Pack will be available in the Jade Shop from January 25, 2024 (after the maintenance), containing Ink Jade x220. Quota: 8
When the Glass Stone Special Pack and Ink Jade Special Pack become available, there's a special limited-time discount starting at 30%. Every time you have collected at least 1 copy of each card of a Shikigami from the Home of Peach Blossom update, you will receive an additional 5% off. If you manage to collect at least 1 copy of each card of all eight Shikigami from the Home of Peach Blossom update, you will be eligible for a maximum discount of 70%!

Ibaraki Doji: Tabidati - New Light Avatar Pack is Available

Shuten Doji: Transcendence - Evil and Good Special Alternative Art Discount is Available Again

Appearances Return

Balance Adjustments

Maddening Melody

Acheron Floral Field

Deal 1 damage to a random opponent Shikigami.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425662/a8fd33c2542f2fa3b8c2d837c1e2b2cd576f3458.png[/img]
Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on December 7, 2023.

Winter Championship Has Begun!
Event Time: From after the maintenance on December 7 to 24:00 on December 16.
Event Description:
· Guests can sign up for the Golden Autumn Championship, pick their best deck, and compete with other guests for the championship.
· The event is divided into three stages: qualifiers, semi-finals, and finals.
· During the event, all Shikigami and cards from Four Guardians, Good or Evil, Fleeting Dreams, Paradise Chords, and Ethereal Essence cannot be used.
· Guests can register up to three times per day during the qualifier/semi-final stage. The first registration is free and subsequent registrations will each cost 10,000 Gold. Guests can register twice in total during the finals, both for free.
· The deck selected cannot be modified after each registration. The challenge ends after winning 5 games or losing 2 games.
· Opening time:
Qualifiers: Open all day from after the maintenance on December 7, 2023 to 24:00 on December 10, 2023.
Semi-finals: Open all day from December 11, 2023 to 24:00 on December 14, 2023.
Finals: Open all day from December 15, 2023 to 24:00 on December 16, 2023.
· Guests can gain Gold and Random Card Packs based on the number of wins in each challenge. Guests who advance to the finals will have a chance to get the limited title Ode of Snow, the limited card back Warm Winter, random Card Packs, Glass Stones and more rewards!

Toughness Quests Now Available
· After the maintenance on December 7, guests can select a Shikigami in Toughness Quest at the Mission Office. After completing a quest of the Shikigami, guests can additionally obtain 5 Toughness as a reward.
· You can complete Toughness Quests 5 times per day. When the attempts are not 0, you can change the selected Shikigami at any time.
· When a Shikigami's Toughness reaches 2000, you won't be able to receive Toughness Quests of the Shikigami.
· Toughness Quests can only be completed in Ranked Match or Sealed Deck.
· During this update, Shikigami that can be selected in the Toughness Quests include:
Puppeteer, Hako Shoujo, Warrior Soul, Kusa, Kyonshi Ototo, Tesso, Shiro, Kuro, Chin, Viper Ning, Kyonshi Ani, Ubume, Kyonshi Imoto, Kanko, Ibaraki Doji, Yamakaze, Inugami, Hana, Joruri Gozen, Sakura Yukihime, Genkuro, Hitorima, Miketsu, Kyuumei Neko, Umibozu, Enenra, Jikikaeru, Usagi, Kujira, Gaki.

Aoandon: Wildfire - Anecdote Avatar Pack Now Available
· Aoandon: Wildfire - Anecdote Avatar Pack will be available in the Jade Shop after the maintenance on December 7, 2023. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time and end at 24:00 on December 20.

Emoji Feature Improvements
· The number of Shikigami Emojis that can be sent during a match has been increased from 4 to 6.
· You can now send Shikigami Emojis that you own on the World Channel, Room Channel, and when chatting with your friends.

Rotating Shikigami Trial
· During each turn of the Rotating Shikigami Trial event, guests can try all cards of 12 specific Shikigami for free.
· Available time of this rotation: From 00:00 on December 15, 2023 to 24:00 on December 31, 2023.
· Trial Shikigami during this rotation: Yamawaro, Hououka, Kaguya, Hana, Fujihime, Puppeteer, Kurumi, Mannendake, Juzu, Mushishi, Sasori Onna, Jinkougyou.

Balance Adjustments
· The following cards have been adjusted:

Steel Feathers
Changed the basic boost to +2 Power/+1 Shield.
Changed the effect to: Origin: Dark Featherblade Hunt

Rapid Shadow
Changed the effect to: Nightfall 5: Gain Fatal when attacking a Shikigami.

· The following cards have been enhanced

Soul Guiding
Changed the basic boost to +0 Power/+2 Shield.

Subdue the Demons
Changed the basic boost to +0 Power/+2 Shield.

Mujou's Command
Changed the effect to: Make one of your Shikigami gain 2 Shield and launch an attack, and the attack damage dealt by this attack gains Fatal.

Target Lock
Changed the effect to: When Viper Ning deals non-attack damage to an opponent Shikigami, the Shikigami cannot assault or use Combat cards the next turn. Charged: Deal 3 damage to an opponent Shikigami when entering the battlefield.

Forest Treasure
Changed the effect to: Once every turn, when your uncharged Shikigami uses a Combat card or non-Evolve Spell card, copy it and charge. The target is the same, and gain 1 Orb.

Emerging Dreams
Changed the effect to: Once every turn, this card does not cost any Orbs when it is linked to and used by your Shikigami. When linked to your Shikigami, deal 1 damage to all opponent Shikigami.

Tang Bamboo
Changed the effect to: When in Specter Form, lose Direct Hit, and gain Fatal.

Harakiri
Changed the effect to: Become defeated, and draw 1 card. Gain +1 Power when in Specter Form during this game.

Void Soul
Changed the effect to: When in Specter Form, gain Hunt and +1 Power.

Evolve: Shiranui
Changed the effect to: Rally: Gain Piercing during this turn. Evolve: At the start of your turn, Rally: Gain +1 Power. Your Rally effect additionally gains +1 Power and +1 Shield.

Blazing Flame
Changed the basic stats to 2 Power/2 Health.

Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on December 13, 2023. (Up to twice for each type)

Alternative Art System Update
· Added a new feature: You can tap on the Default/Priority button of an Evolve card's Alternative Art in Shikigami to choose whether to use the Evolve card's card cover as the Basic card's card cover.
· To avoid confusion during matches, this effect is only visible to the players themselves.

Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on November 23, 2023.
Night of Savile II Begins!
Event Time: From after the maintenance on November 23, 2023 to 24:00 on December 6, 2023.
Event Description:
· During the event, you will collect clues and uncover the truth as a reporter for the Savile Daily.

Shuten Doji: Transcendence - Evil and Good Special Alternative Art Now Available

Shuten Doji: Transcendence - Crimson Rain Avatar Pack Available

Rotating Shikigami Trial

Immovable

Bathing Song

Flower Falls and Four Seasons Arise
