notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425662/a8fd33c2542f2fa3b8c2d837c1e2b2cd576f3458.png[/img]
Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on November 9, 2023.

Major Update: Log in to Get a Shikigami of Your Choice for Free
Event Time: The event will begin after the maintenance on November 9, 2023, and will continue indefinitely.
Event Description:
· After the maintenance on November 9, guests can claim Shikigami of their choice in the 5-Day Login PYO Shikigami event on the event page.
· Once per guest with no time limit: Select 12 Shikigami from Classic, Nightless Fire, Moonlit Fantasy, Slice Up the Sea, and Fortune and Enmusubi Data Packs, and obtain all of their cards (2 copies for each card)!
· If you have already owned all cards of the selected Shikigami, or none of them is your desired Shikigami, you have the option to claim Alternative Art Shards instead. You can do this by tapping on a Shikigami for which you have collected all the cards. (Please check if you have all the cards of the Shikigami beforehand) Once you've collected a certain number of Alternative Art Shards, you can exchange them for Alternative Art.

The Shinkiro Fete Event Is Now Available!
Event Time: From after the maintenance on November 9, 2023 to 24:00 on November 22, 2023.
Event Description:
· Adjusted the stage pool of some Lords and added some skills. You can check them out in the event.
· During the event, you can choose two from the four factions, and pick one initial skill from each of the two factions to start the challenge.
· During the challenge, you can use all Shikigami of the two factions you choose (except Kyonshi Imoto, Paper Man Warrior, and Imp Gang) and all their cards (except Alternative Art cards) to build a deck and challenge the stages.
For each stage cleared, the four Shikigami you used will become unavailable for the following stages, so build your deck wisely!
· Each round of the challenge has eight stages, after clearing stage II, IV, and VI, you can select an additional skill to help you continue challenging.
· Each time you fail in the challenge, you will have a total of three chances to revive, costing 500/800/1000 Gold respectively. If your revival chances are exhausted, the challenge will be considered a failure.
· All eight stages have their own reward claiming chances. You will get no rewards if all chances are used up.
After the event begins, each time you log into the game, you can accumulate one chance to claim rewards for all 8 stages, up to 5 times in each stage. When there are remaining chances, you can obtain Glass Jade by completing a stage.
· You can use Glass Jade to redeem the limited Title: Pursuit of Domination, limited Transition Wallpaper: Zodiac Clash, Daruma Tokens, Mortal Reincarnation Card Pack, Glass Stone, and Ink Jade.

Sandalwood Moon Lucky Bag Event Starts!
· Event Time: From after the maintenance on November 9, 2023 to 24:00 on November 22, 2023.
· During the event, guests can spend 1 Daruma Token or 60 Jade to draw a lucky bag once.
· Up to 4 Daruma Tokens can be obtained by participating in Shinkiro Fete.
· Unused Daruma Tokens during the event period can be kept for the next event.
· The Lucky Bag Draw rewards are removed from the reward pool once they have been drawn. The system will randomly draw a not yet obtained prize for the guest, according to the draw rate weight of the prizes left.
· The Lucky Bag contains Kujaku Myouou Collector Edition Alternative Art - Requiem, Alternative Art Avatar - Kujaku Myouou: Slumber, Alternative Art Shards, and more amazing rewards.
· You can get the rest of the rewards after obtaining the reward of the black Daruma on top.

Expert Pre-built Deck: Feather of Truth Soon Available in Jade Shop
· Available Time: From after the maintenance on November 9, 2023.
· Expert Pre-built Deck: Feather of Truth contains 2 SSR Cards: Evolve: Kujaku Myouou and Righteous Path, and 6 SR Cards. If you need to strengthen your deck, head to the Jade Shop to get yours!

The Tales of Travel Event Is Now Available!
Event Time: From after the maintenance on November 9, 2023 to 24:00 on November 22, 2023.
Event Description:
· During the event, guests can claim Tale Shards via the event page or by participating in Player Matches.
· Collect a certain amount of Tale Shards to unlock Tale Scrolls, experience the stories of Mortal Reincarnation, and obtain Mortal Reincarnation Card Packs, Transition Wallpapers, Tale Scrolls, and more!
· Collect a certain amount of Tale Scrolls to redeem Mortal Reincarnation Card Packs, Glass Stones, Ink Jade, Toughness Stones, and more!

New System: Rotating Shikigami Trial
· During each turn of the Rotating Shikigami Trial event, guests can try all cards of 12 specific Shikigami for free.
· Available time of this rotation: From after the maintenance on November 9, 2023 to 00:00 on November 23, 2023. Trial Shikigami will be rotated on the 1st and 15th of every month.
· Trial Shikigami during this rotation: Yamausagi, Zashiki, Komatsu, Kiyohime, Suzuka Gozen, Maestro, Ichimokuren, Yamakaze, Kaguya, Susabi, Ungaikyo, and Enmusubi.

SE21 Approaches
SE21 is about to start!
· SE21 of Onmyoji: The Card Game will start at 00:00 on November 16, 2023. Season Special Basic Alternative Art - Ungaikyo: Mirror in the Dark, Avatar - Enma, Permanent Battlefield Special Effects - Seal: Funeral Flowers and Level Up: Stellar Signs, Dynamic Card Back - Auspicious Steps on Pine, Transition Wallpaper - Splash Around, Match Emoji, Glass Card Frame: Basic, and other great rewards await you!
· During the season, the Level 50 rewards for Deluxe Tour Pass and Gilded Tour Pass are Glass Card Frame: Basic x2.
· There is a higher chance of getting cards that you don't have yet when getting the SSR cards in the Tour Pass Rewards. If you've got all of them, then you'll have a higher chance of getting cards that you have fewer than 2 copies of.

Balance Adjustments
· The following cards have been adjusted:

Biora
Changed the basic boost to +2 Power/+0 Shield.

Evolve: Shiki
Changed the basic boost to: +0 Power/+0 Health.

Never Give Up
Changed the basic stats to 3 Power/6 Health.

Oshiroi Babaa
Changed the effect to: Once every turn, when you or Oshiroi Babaa receive excessive healing, Projectile: Deal 1 damage.

Powder Compact
Changed the basic stats to 2 Power/2 Health.
Changed the effect to: Fusion.#rWhen taking damage, self-destructs.

Evolve: Sakura
Changed the effect to: Put a Falling Sakura in your hand.#rEvolve: Sakura can recover the Health of your defeated Shikigami. If she does so, -1 to its defeat countdown instead. She can also deal damage to the opponent's defeated Shikigami. If she does so, +1 to its defeat countdown instead.

Gorgeous Dance
Changed the basic stats to 3 Power/5 Health.

Aftertaste
Changed the effect to: Repeat 3 times and remove the top card of your library. If it is a Combat card, make Gaki attack once; if it is a Form card, recover 4 Health; if it is any Other card, draw 1 card.

· The following cards have been enhanced

Immovable
Changed the effect to: When entering the battlefield, move Samurai X to the Combat Zone.#rIf Samurai X is in the Combat Zone at the start of your turn, gain 3 Power.

Moving Fortress
Changed the effect to: When entering the battlefield, give Samurai X 2 Shield.#rWhen Samurai X has Shield, the damage he takes is limited to his Shield.

Evolve: Samurai X
Changed the basic boost to: +1 Power/+1 Health.

Evolve: Entry
Changed the effect to: Evolve: Countdown 3: Deal 5 damage randomly split among all opponent units.#rWhen you play a Maestro's Evolve Spell card, Maestro's countdown -3.

Maddening Melody
Changed the effect to: Countdown +2 for an opponent Shikigami, and countdown -3 for Maestro.

Soul Binder
Changed the effect to: Deal 5 damage to an opponent Shikigami, then Etch.

Evolve: Yuki Onna
Changed the effect to: Deal 3 damage to 1 Shikigami.#rEvolve: Stun any Shikigami damaged by Yuki Onna.#rGain a Snowball card when you stun an opponent Shikigami, once per turn.

Evolve: Yuki
Changed the effect to: Stun an opponent unit.#rEvolve: Yuki gains Double Strike and is immune to attack damage when engaging a stunned opponent unit.

Evolve: Satori
Changed the effect to: Evolve: At the start of the turn, reveal all cards in the opponent's hand. When the opponent player plays a revealed card, Satori gains 1 Power and 1 Health.

Evolve: Hitotsume
Changed the basic stats to +2 Power/+1 Health.

Evolve: Kawazaru
Changed the effect to: Evolve: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Master Shapeshifter that does not cost any Orbs and can be played on the opponent Shikigami.

Ring Toss
Changed the effect to: Turn the Shikigami in the opponent's Combat Zone into a Paper Man, and draw a card. Enhance: If you rolled a 6 for 3 times during this game, turn it into a Paper Doll.#rTrigger: Play automatically when Yamausagi is attacked.

Paper Man/Paper Doll
Changed the effect to: At the end of your turn, revert to your original Shikigami.

Kunlun Enigma
Changed the effect to: Fast#rStun an opponent Shikigami and remove its Barrier, Unyielding, and charged status.

Unstoppable Force
Changed the effect to: Countdown 3: Deal 5 damage to the opponent player and make the opponent player unable to recover Health until the next turn starts.

Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on November 15, 2023. (Up to twice for each type)
Due to the adjustments made to Oshiroi Babaa's basic abilities, guests can collect compensation of 1,000 Talismans from the maintenance mail.

Improvements and Bug Fixes
· Fixed a bug related to Aoandon: Wildfire Book of Tales. Previously, when selecting an Anecdote, if the turn ended due to action timeout, the opponent player might have been unable to upgrade during the next turn.
· Fixed the bug where triggering Shinkiro: Formation Breaker and discarding Hyakushiki: Violet Rock to defeat the opponent Shikigami would also eliminate the corresponding summon Shikigami.
· Fixed the bug where using Guiding Flame after Koroka gains a Health bonus would not reduce Koroka's Health to 1.
· Fixed the bug where, in Hyakubun Chess, when a Mio player uses Cloud Youkai to devour Cloud Youkai, Ootengu on the battlefield would gain 2 Energy.

notes.title: Maintenance Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425662/a8fd33c2542f2fa3b8c2d837c1e2b2cd576f3458.png[/img]
Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on October 26, 2023.

The Mortal Reincarnation Data Pack Is Here
The new Mortal Reincarnation data pack of Onmyoji: The Card Game is now available, featuring unique Trick and Stacking gameplay as well as 8 new Shikigami.
· Mortal Reincarnation Card Packs will be available after the maintenance on October 26, 2023. 
· The card pack includes 8 new Shikigami: Kujaku Myouou, Shiki, Shuten Doji: Transcendence, Ibaraki Doji: Tabidati, Aobozu: Mundane Life, Hangan: Hanging Ink, Oshiroi Babaa, and Shouzu.
· After the new Mortal Reincarnation data pack becomes available on October 26, guests will be able to claim 3 free Mortal Reincarnation Card Packs by logging into the game. 
· The Mortal Reincarnation Card Pack rebate event will be available after the maintenance on October 26, 2023 until 24:00 of November 14, 2023. During the event, when purchasing any 10 card packs with Jade, guests will get 1 free Mortal Reincarnation Card Pack, up to 5 packs.
· The 8 Shikigami of the Mortal Reincarnation Card Pack are now all available. More Shikigami will be obtainable from new Card Packs or by other means in the future. 

Mortal Reincarnation Data Pack Adjustments
· Added the Master Collector title for the Mortal Reincarnation data pack. 
· Changed the requirement of the Supreme Collector title to collecting all cards of the 156 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included). 
· Changed the requirement of the Inked Heart title to collecting all Inked cards of the 156 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· Changed the requirement of the Bright Glaze title to collecting all Glass Card Frames of the 156 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· The Mortal Reincarnation Card Packs can now be purchased in the Hyakubun Scrollery.
· Added 8 new Shikigami of the Mortal Reincarnation data pack to Sealed Deck. 
· The card pack rewards from Sealed Deck will include Mortal Reincarnation Card Packs. The random card rewards will include cards of the 8 new Shikigami from the Mortal Reincarnation data pack. 
· The rewards of Kaidan Chapter 1, 2 & 3 will include cards of the 8 new Shikigami from the Mortal Reincarnation data pack.

The Mortal Reincarnation Pack is Now Available
· Mortal Reincarnation Special Card Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on October 26, 2023, containing 30 Mortal Reincarnation Card Packs.
· Mortal Reincarnation Welcome Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on October 26, 2023, containing 10 Mortal Reincarnation Card Packs.

Among the Mt. Ibuki Event Begins!
Event Time: From after the maintenance on October 26, 2023 to 24:00 on November 22, 2023.
Event Description:
· During the event, guests can use Blood Crystal to unlock the locations in the realm, and by completing special matches during the exploration.
· Complete event quests to obtain Blood Crystals.
· After unlocking a location, if there is a special match in that location, you can continue to unlock the next location even if you have not completed the match.
· Complete special matches to obtain a certain amount of Blood Crystals.
· The difficulty of special matches increases as guests venture further.
· Guests will receive a certain number of Pure Crystals for each location unlocked.
· Guests can spend Pure Crystals to redeem Transition Wallpaper - Among the Mt. Ibuki, Mortal Reincarnation Card Packs, match emoji, Ink Jade, and other rewards.

Mid-Autumn Moon-Gazing - Voyage Pass: S1 Now Available
· Guests can spend 248 Jade to purchase the Voyage Pass: S1. Once purchased, Voyage Pass: S1 will be instantly leveled up to Lv.9, allowing guests to immediately earn all exclusive Doodle Alternative Art of the current Voyage Pass. This includes Doodle Alternative Art for Yamausagi's base Shikigami and its 8 cards, along with the corresponding 9 Inked Card Frames.
· The Voyage Pass has a total of 30 levels. Guests can earn points by completing the specified point quests to level up the Voyage Pass. Claim corresponding rewards once the Voyage Pass reaches a certain level. Each reward can only be claimed once.
· Guests can directly purchase Voyage Pass levels. Please spend money responsibly.

Full-set of Kagewani Doodle Alternative Art Is Back for a Limited Time
· The Kagewani Doodle Alternative Art Pack will be available in the Jade Shop after the maintenance on October 26, 2023 to 00:00 on November 23, 2023. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.
· The gift pack contains Doodle Alternative Art for Kagewani's base Shikigami and its eight cards.

PYO SSR Card Pack Now Available
· PYO SSR Card Pack will be available in the Jade Shop from 10:00 on October 26, 2023 to 24:00 on November 8, 2023. Guests can purchase it in the Jade Shop.

· Fixed the bug where the targets and the Combat cards' effects could be incorrect when some Combat cards with the ability to select targets are charged and played.

· Fixed the bug where, when Shinkiro was turned into Serpent Demon, it was possible to receive the same Faction Power multiple times after using Misty Moonnight.
· Fixed the bug where, after Shinkiro used the first Formation Breaker and discarded the Hyakushiki card, the following Formation Breaker could trigger matching effects without discarding the Hyakushiki card.

· Optimized the animation speed when cards are shuffled to the library. The animation duration for Shiki's cards has been further reduced.
· Fixed the bug where, when Fukengaku Field was defeated, the recovering effect might trigger multiple times.
· Fixed the bug where, when the effect of Coming Storm reduced the countdown for Ootengu: Steel Storm, the countdown of Evolve: Yamakaze wasn't reduced.
· Fixed the bug where Revival Blossom might gain Fast after Momo was defeated.

· Changed the requirement of the Inked Heart title to collecting all Inked cards of the 147 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· Changed the requirement of the Bright Glaze title to collecting all Glass Card Frames of the 147 Shikigami (guests who already have this title will not be affected, Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included).
· The Lantern Tales Card Packs can now be purchased in the Hyakubun Scrollery.
· Added 8 new Shikigami of the Lantern Tales data pack to Sealed Deck. 
· The card pack rewards from Sealed Deck will include Lantern Tales Card Packs. The random card rewards will include cards of the 8 new Shikigami from the Lantern Tales data pack. 
· The rewards of Kaidan Chapter 1, 2 & 3 will include cards of the 8 new Shikigami from the Lantern Tales data pack.

The Lantern Tales Pack is Now Available
· The Lantern Tales Special Card Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on July 27, 2023, containing 30 Lantern Tales Card Packs.
· The Lantern Tales Welcome Pack will be available in Jade Shop after maintenance on July 27, 2023, containing 10 Lantern Tales Card Packs.

The Realm Encounter Event Is Now Available!
· Event Time: From after the maintenance on July 27, 2023 to 24:00 on August 9, 2023.
Event Description:
· During the event, guests can use Lanterns to unlock the locations in the realm, and obtain a total of 6 Lantern Tales Card Packs by completing special puzzle matches during the exploration.
· After unlocking a location, if there is a special match in that location, you can continue to unlock the next location even if you have not completed the match.
· Guests will receive a certain number of Lantern Flames for each normal location unlocked.
· For each location with a special puzzle unlocked, guests will get 1 Lantern Tales Card Pack and a certain number of Lantern Flames. After successfully challenging a location's special match for the first time, guests will receive more Lantern Flames.
· The difficulty of special puzzle matches as guests venture further.
· Players can spend Lantern Flames to redeem Transition Wallpaper - Realm Encounter, Limited Avatar Frame - Dreamlike, Lantern Tales Card Packs, match emoji, Ink Jade, and other rewards.
· Complete event quests to obtain Lanterns.

Kusa: Light of Courage Alternative Art Now in the Shop
· Special Alternative Art - Kusa: Light of Courage will be available in the Alternative Art Shop after the maintenance on July 27, 2023. A limited-time offer will also be available at the same time. The limited-time discount will end on 24:00 August 9.

Balance Adjustments
· The mechanics of Poison have been adjusted:
Poisoned units can be healed now.
Effects that increase Health can now take effect on Poisoned units.
Playing a Form card will reset Shikigami's Health.

Desire for Power
Changed the effect to: Once per turn, when Shishio attacks or is attacked, gain 1 Energy and 2 Shield.

· The following cards have been nerfed:
Larva
Changed the effect to:
Countdown 2: Deal 1 Poison damage to an opponent Shikigami at random.

· The following cards have been enhanced:
Mark of Mushi
Changed the basic stats to 4 Power/5 Health.
Changed the effect to:
When entering the battlefield, Shelter. Once per turn, when a Poisoned Shikigami is defeated, you recover the same amount of Health as the current Health of the defeated Shikigami Defeated.

Life's Dominion
Changed the effect to:
When entering the battlefield, move Sasori Onna to the Combat Zone. When an opponent Shikigami is Poisoned, Sasori Onna gains 2 Shield. If this card is Sheltered, then when entering the battlefield, Projectile: deal 2 Poison damage.

Vicious Venom
Changed the effect to:
Unyielding. Once per turn, when Sasori Onna deals attack damage to an opponent unit, she also inflicts Poison on them. (Effective against player) If this card is Sheltered, then gain extra Lifesteal.

Evolve: Momo
Changed the effect to: Recover 5 Health for 1 unit. Evolve: When Momo heals or revives one of your Shikigami, it gains 2 Power and 2 Health permanently.

Revival Blossom
Changed the effect to: If Momo is not defeated, this card gains Fast. Revive all your Shikigami and give them Haste. (Playable when Momo is defeated)

Cascading Feathers
Changed the basic boost to +1 Power/+0 Shield.
Changed the effect to: This card is regarded as Golden Feather when played. If a Golden Feather was played during this turn, this card does not cost any Orbs.

Feather Dance
Changed the effect to: If a Golden Feather was played during this turn, put a Cascading Feathers in your Hand.

Moneymaker
Changed the basic stats to 4 Power/4 Health.

Mouse Treasure
Changed the effect to: When entering the battlefield, place 1 Lucky Coin into your hand. All Lucky Coin cards in your hand gain "Trigger: When Tesso takes damage, automatically play this card and become immune to the current damage."

Forest Vines
Changed the effect to: Stun a Shikigami and deal 4 damage. Burst 2: Gains Fast.

Scale Protection
Changed the basic stats to 4 Power/7 Health.

Gorgeous Dance
Changed the effect to: When an opponent Shikigami attacks, deal 2 damage to it (whether it is defeated or not). When Sakura uses spell, deal 1 damage to an opponent Shikigami at random (whether it is defeated or not).

Evolve: Sakura
Changed the effect to: Put a Falling Sakura in your hand and give it Fast. Evolve: Sakura can recover the #[生命] of your defeated Shikigami. If she does so, -1 to its defeat countdown instead. She can also deal damage to the opponent's defeated Shikigami. If she does so, +1 to its defeat countdown instead.

Cards that have been adjusted can be disenchanted according to their crafting price before 10:00 on August 2, 2023. (Up to twice for each type)
Since the basic ability Poison has been adjusted, guests (including new guests) can claim 1 PYO SSR Card Pack via mail after the maintenance.

Other Improvements and Bug Fixes
· Fixed an issue where Matsu could not be used normally when linked to Suzuka Gozen's Unprecedented.
· Fixed an issue where the dynamic text of Menreiki's Form Mask of Reincarnation would be repeatedly displayed.
· Fixed an issue when the Divination effect of Baizhe's Way Around World was triggered by Lord Arakawa's Form Returning Home, Way Around World failed to take effect.

Honored Guest, Onmyoji: The Card Game is undergoing a scheduled maintenance from 9:00 to 10:30 on May 11, 2023.

Shikigami Toughness System Now Available
· Toughness System Introduction
Toughness can, to some extent, represent how long and how well you've used Shikigami. The more times a Shikigami wins and the higher the win rate, the higher its Toughness (Paper Man Warriors and Imp Gang not included)
You can check out each Shikigami's Toughness under Proficiency in Shikigami - Shikigami Details.
Participating in Ranked Match will change Shikigami's Toughness. Winning a match will increase the Toughness of the Shikigami used, while losing a match will decrease the Toughness of the Shikigami used.
In Ranked Match, changes of Toughness are subject to corrections due to factors including Tier, if the Shikigami's Toughness has reached 1000, and how many times the Shikigami has been used during this season.
Participating in Sealed Deck will also change Shikigami's Toughness. At the settlement of Sealed Deck, Shikigami will gain Toughness according to its corresponding wins.
There's no upper limit for Toughness. Toughness above 1000 will be reset partially with season settlement. 1001 - 3000: Reset to 40%; Above 3000: Reset to 20%. (For example, 3200 Toughness will be reset to: 1000+2000×40%+200×20%=1840 Toughness)
· Toughness Rankings
When a Shikigami's Toughness reaches 1000, it is qualified to enter its Toughness Rankings.
Tap "Shikigami" on the left in Ranked Match's Rankings to enter the Shikigami Toughness Rankings. You can also enter the corresponding Shikigami Toughness Rankings in Shikigami Details - Toughness - Check Ranking.
In Shikigami's Toughness Rankings, tap Shikigami's avatar on the left to see all Shikigami's Toughness and rankings.
· About Toughness Rewards
Each Shikigami can obtain redemption materials for the Toughness card frame when its highest Toughness reaches 1000. Each subsequent 100 Toughness will grant a corresponding reward (reach 2000 to get all rewards). When a Shikigami's Toughness reaches 1200, you can get an exclusive Toughness basic card frame of that Shikigami. (exclusive Toughness frame will be available soon) Rewards for Shikigami's highest Toughness. Each reward can be only redeemed once for each Shikigami.
Shikigami Toughness Rankings will be calculated with season settlements. You will obtain different amounts of redemption materials for the Toughness card frame based on rankings. If multiple Shikigami have entered the rankings, rewards will be issued based on the highest ranking.
When the results of the Shikigami Toughness Rankings are calculated, the 1st place of each Shikigami's rankings will gain the exclusive Top of Shinkiro title of the corresponding Shikigami. Titles will be recycled at next season's settlement.
The first settlement will be carried out at (00:00 on July 1, 2023). Season 16's settlement will not reset Toughness over 1000, and ranking rewards will not be calculated.

notes.title: 《Onmyoji: The Card Game》Coming to Steam on January 5th
notes.content:
Hello, all new and old guests! The long wait is finally over, we will launch on Steam at 11:00 on January 5th! The Mirage will then open its doors to welcome guests aboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43425662/69e372f4d0dfb9394a1c13a62a83388a6711d23c.png[/img]

Onmyoji: The Card Game is an exquisite Japanese-style duel card game. Board Shinkiro, a mirage ship that travels between the three realms, as a youkai, choose 4 from more than 120 different Shikigami and build your own deck, power-up your Shikigami during the combat, and enjoy a fair and thrilling duel with brand-new original rules.
